data.jd_text:
The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.

Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Markets, and Global Financial Solutions, you will build pipelines, lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle, and convert opportunities into long\-term client relationships. You will represent CSC® externally with fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions, and key referral partners such as law firms and professional services firms. This role is suited to a high\-energy “hunter” with a strong network and a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
 



  





**Some of the things you’ll be doing:** 



* Proactively originate, qualify, and win new fund sales opportunities across the UAE.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network with external business partners (including law firms and professional services firms), deepening existing relationships and unlocking new referral sources.
* Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including discovery, solution positioning, presentations, deal management, follow\-ups, and negotiation.
* Collaborate with Global Financial Solutions and Markets teams to position CSC’s product suite, including fund administration, SPV services, depositary, AIFM, and strategic outsourcing solutions.
* Develop account and territory plans, including go\-to\-market activity plans, aligned to revenue targets and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate and contribute to proposals and RFP responses in partnership with the Funds Market team and other subject matter experts.
* Conduct deal\-by\-deal risk assessment and ensure new opportunities meet internal governance, regulatory expectations, and commercial criteria.
* Monitor market and competitor trends and provide actionable insights to support commercial strategy and growth planning.
* Represent CSC at client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and seminars to promote brand visibility and generate pipeline.
* Use sales tools and technology (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Preqin or similar platforms) to manage pipeline, forecasting, activity tracking, and reporting.








**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?** 



* Demonstrated success in a business development / sales role with consistent achievement against quotas or revenue targets (new business acquisition focus).
* Experience selling to, or within, the fund management community (e.g., fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions) or selling closely related financial services solutions into that client base.
* Strong network within the fund management community and ability to build referral channels with law firms and professional services partners.
* Proven ability to run complex, consultative sales cycles, coordinate internal stakeholders, and close deals.
* Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills, and ability to assess opportunity risk and fit.
* Proficiency with CRM and sales enablement tools, including Salesforce (or similar), with disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Knowledge of fund servicing models and products such as fund administration, depositary, AIFM, SPVs, or strategic outsourcing.
* Existing partner relationships across the UAE fund management community.
* Experience selling regulated services and navigating governance, compliance, and risk review processes during onboarding.
* Strong presentation skills and experience representing an organisation at industry events and conferences.








**A typical career progression** 
 path could look like: Business Development Director → Senior Business Development Director / Sales Leader → Regional Sales Head / Commercial Director (Funds).
 



 Cross\-functional opportunities: pathways into Product Strategy, Funds Market Leadership, Key Account Management, or broader Global Financial Solutions commercial leadership roles.
 



 Compensation: competitive salary plus a commission plan aligned to individual performance and revenue outcomes (details discussed during the interview process), with access to CSC benefits and additional incentives as applicable.
 



  





**Why work with CSC?** 




 At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to improve and anticipate the future needs of our customers. Curiosity fuels our innovation and productivity drives our results. This proactive mindset has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 120 years.
 



 CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose personal values align with ours. We empower our employees to bring the right solutions to market to meet customer demand. That is why we are the premier provider of global solutions for more than 180,000 businesses.
 



  




* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have been voted a Top Workplace every year since 2006\.
* We offer challenging work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.
* Employees are eligible for success sharing, bonus, or commission plans based on role and individual performance.
* CSC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package as part of your Total Rewards that includes annual leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referral bonuses, and more.



  





**About us** 




 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®
 



 CSC is committed to creating a diverse and growth\-oriented environment where everyone is valued and respected. CSC offers challenging career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success\-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers.
 



  





 Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

 What You'll Do

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management.  A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.

* Enable commercial success by creating visibility into local platforms (e.g., local BCG lead calls), synthesizing insights, and supporting senior stakeholders with actionable steering information
* People \& Talent Management
* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs
* Shape the Middle East hiring strategy jointly with Inverto EMESA and local recruiting teams, contributing to the attraction and retention of top consulting talent and enhancing the effectiveness of selection processes
* Coordinate and improve professional development initiatives \- including career development, training, retention, and team affiliation \- liaising with EMESA team
* Lead local people\-related initiatives that strengthen team cohesion and organizational culture
* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams
* Support driving the Teaming process in partnership with Inverto’s central Teaming Team, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Financial Planning \& Performance Management
* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration \& Data flow
* Maintain strong and effective collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA teams (BST, HR, IT, etc.), enhancing cross\-functional processes and ensuring smooth operational integration
* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management \& Compliance Coordination
* Support governance, risk management, and compliance efforts by ensuring alignment of local operations with Inverto EMESA and BCG Core requirements, while proactively identifying improvement areas
* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination \& Office Enablement
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Gold And Minerals Joint Stock Company**
 Gold and Minerals is a leading exploration and development company specializing in gold and base metal projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With a strong focus on sustainable and responsible mining practices, the company is committed to unlocking the Kingdom’s rich mineral potential while contributing to its economic growth.

 **Jabal Qutman Gold** 
 ,
 **Wadi Bidah Copper\-Gold and Ajlan JV** 
 projects, positioning it as one of the key players in Saudi Arabia’s growing mining sector. In response to the Kingdom’s strategic initiatives to expand the mining industry, Gold and Minerals is actively expanding its team to support its ambitious exploration and development programs.
   

  

 Our team consists of highly skilled, multinational geologists and mining professionals working collaboratively across resource expansion, project development, and greenfield exploration projects. We foster a dynamic, innovative, and safety\-focused work environment that encourages professional growth, knowledge sharing, and career advancement.
   

  

 At Gold and Minerals , we are passionate about creating value for our stakeholders while maintaining the highest standards of environmental stewardship and community engagement.
   

  

 Joining our team means being part of a forward\-thinking organization that is shaping the future of mining in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for providing strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the newly formed joint venture. Ensures execution of shareholders’ joint exploration, resource definition, project development, and assessment through to mining strategy and operational mine site. Drives value creation by ensuring safe business operations, efficient implementation, innovation, team development, adherence to timelines, and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver the JV’s work program as committed to MIM.
* Develop and execute work programs aligned with project requirements and exploration results to meet timelines.
* Manage operational functions and ensure delivery of approved plans.
* Assess and optimize future mining projects.
* Ensure safe operations across exploration, project definition, construction, and mining activities.
* Manage costs within approved budgets.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting to shareholders and MIM.
* Maintain strong governance standards, including procurement compliance.
* Lead and develop high\-performing leadership teams and promote a strong safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with legal, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including mining license applications.
* Represent both shareholders’ interests within the joint venture.
* Ensure effective engagement with local communities and stakeholders.


**Key Work Interactions**
 Internal Relationships
   

  

* Joint Venture Technical Committee
* Shareholders
* Employees
* Site General Managers and Operations
* Shareholder financial teams


 External Relationships
   

  

* Communities
* Government agencies and regulatory bodies
* Consultants and engineering firms
* Equipment and technology suppliers
* Adjacent license holders
* Contractors and service providers


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Mineral Processing, or related field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Health \& Safety certification is desirable
* Valid driving licence in KSA or convertible to KSA licence


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of experience in the mining industry, with at least 10 years in senior leadership roles
* Proven track record in managing advanced exploration projects and delivering feasibility studies
* Experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams and transitioning projects from exploration to development and operations
* Experience in establishing new projects, including policy development, training, and HSE procedures
* Strong understanding of structurally controlled gold deposits, open pit mining, and precious metal processing
* Culturally adept and delivery\-focused
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and communication skills


**Work Schedule**
 This role operates on a FIFO roster in a remote operational location, following a 6 weeks on / 3 weeks off rotation schedule.

* Creates and maintains SH\&E training records.

* Extensive knowledge of Federal and State health and safety regulations and reporting procedures.
* Advanced knowledge of safety\-related national consensus standards (e.g., ANSI, NFPA).
* Exceptional interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
* Ability to perform in a supervisory/managerial capacity.

Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety
* Monitor performance during events and identify improvement opportunities
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across operations


**Key Success Metrics**
* Operational delivery against plan
* Visitor experience and satisfaction
* Health, safety, and security performance
* Efficiency of event execution
* Readiness and delivery of major events


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong experience in large\-scale event operations and delivery
* Ability to manage complex logistics and site operations
* Strong knowledge of crowd management and HSE standards
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Cross\-functional coordination and execution capability


**Requirements**
* 12\-15\+ years of experience, with a significant portion in leadership roles overseeing large\-scale operations and event delivery
* Proven experience in:
* Planning and delivering large\-scale events, festivals, or destination operations with high visitor volumes
* Managing complex, multi\-site or multi\-zone environments involving diverse activities and stakeholders
* Leading end\-to\-end event operations, including planning, logistics, site readiness, and live delivery
* Strong experience in:
* Crowd management, HSE, and security operations within large public events
* Operational planning and logistics, including transport, access, and site movement
* Vendor and contractor management across multiple service lines
* Demonstrated ability to:
* Operate in high\-pressure, real\-time environments with critical decision\-making responsibilities
* Manage and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and security agencies
* Lead large, cross\-functional operational teams and on\-ground workforce
* Experience in:
* Pre\-opening and activation phases of large\-scale venues, events, or destinations (preferred)
* Transitioning from readiness to live operations and managing ongoing operational cycles

Explore our current opportunities and be part of something extraordinary.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and delivery of the core Cultural Festival programming, ensuring a high\-impact, large\-scale cultural program that drives visitor engagement and aligns with asset objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Festival Program Planning**
* Develop, produce, deliver, and manage a high\-volume portfolio of festival programming, including coordination of over 1,400 performances, events, and cultural activities
* Structure programming across multiple zones and time slots to optimize flow and engagement
* Ensure alignment with overall programming strategy and visitor demand, in coordination with Commercial, Cultural Ecosystem, and Marketing teams
* Identify, engage, and manage third\-party program experts, producers, and cultural partners to develop, produce, and deliver festival programming


**Large\-Scale Program Delivery**
* Lead execution of all festival programming, ensuring coordination across multiple venues and activities
* Manage daily program operations, schedules, and real\-time adjustments
* Ensure timely and seamless delivery of all performances and experiences


**Performer \& Participant Management**
* Coordinate onboarding, scheduling, and management of performers, artists, and contributors including regional, international, and government\-affiliated participants and partners
* Ensure readiness of all participants, including rehearsals, technical requirements and performance delivery
* Manage high\-volume and diverse participant groups, ensuring seamless coordination and consistent quality


**Real\-Time Operations \& Optimization**
* Monitor program performance during the festival and adjust schedules dynamically
* Address operational challenges in real time in coordination with Operations
* Ensure continuity and quality under high\-pressure conditions


**Performance Monitoring**
* Track attendance, engagement, and program effectiveness across the festival
* Identify high\-performing and underperforming content
* Provide insights to improve future festival programming


**Key Success Metrics**
* Festival attendance and engagement
* On\-time delivery of programming
* Visitor satisfaction
* Revenue performance of festival programming against budget targets
* Contribution of programming to overall asset financial performance


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Experience in large\-scale event programming
* Strong coordination and execution capability
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure environments


**Requirements**
* 6\-10 years of experience, with a strong background in large\-scale event programming, festival management, or live event delivery
* Proven experience planning and delivering large\-scale festivals, cultural events, or entertainment programs
* Experience managing multi\-day, high\-volume events with multiple simultaneous activities
* Strong understanding of event lifecycle management, from planning through live delivery

* Ability to oversee daily schedules, stage programming, and activity coordination
* Experience handling last\-minute changes, disruptions, and operational challenges during live events
* Experience managing large numbers of performers, artists, and cultural contributors
* Ability to coordinate rehearsals, technical requirements, and performance schedules
* Experience ensuring readiness and smooth delivery across diverse participant groups
* Experience managing programming across multiple stages, zones, or venues simultaneously
* Ability to coordinate parallel activities while maintaining consistency and quality
* Strong understanding of crowd flow, timing, and programming distribution
* Experience leading teams, coordinators, and on\-ground staff during live events
* Experience in major national events, festivals, or large public events
* Experience in cultural or entertainment programming environments
* Experience in pre\-opening or launching large\-scale events is an advantage

**Build the Future of Rail in the Middle East with Mace**
 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experienced Professionals Across**
* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Determines and coordinates project management, technical services, and external resources required to deliver projects effectively on behalf of the client.
* Collaborates with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to align strategies and ensure successful project delivery.
* Promotes a strong safety culture by demonstrating visible safety leadership and implementing health and safety frameworks.
* Provides subject matter expertise and leverages organisational knowledge to support optimal project outcomes.
* Procures and manages design teams and consultants, overseeing scopes, deliverables, fees, variations, and claims.
* Develops and integrates design, authority, procurement, and delivery programmes to support end\-to\-end project execution.
* Leads project delivery from inception through construction, ensuring alignment with project plans, KPIs, timelines, budgets, and risk management strategies.
* Oversees stakeholder coordination, quality assurance, change management, and handover documentation to ensure successful project completion.


**About You**
 You will bring proven experience in major rail or infrastructure programmes, coupled with the ability to operate in complex, fast‑paced delivery environments. Equally important is a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence — qualities that define how we partner with our clients and deliver lasting impact.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of something evolving — to help establish, shape, and grow a rail capability in a region where investment in integrated transport is accelerating at pace.
   

  

 If you are motivated by delivering complex programmes, working with high‑performing teams, and contributing to the development of world‑class infrastructure, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.
   

  

 Join us in delivering the next generation of rail across the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. **Responsibilities?**
 We are recruiting experienced Telecoms Engineer, capable of lead \& supervise, Installation, Test and Commissioning of telecom systems for following disciplines for railway system;
   

  

* TCP/IP, IP\-MPLS,
* CCTV
* Video Management System
* PABX \& PSTN \& VoIP Cards
* TETRA Radio Systems
* Public Address system
* Passenger Information System
* BBRS/WiFi
* Cybersecurity ( preferable )


 Experienced and capable of using relevant test equipment, understand, verify design requirements and BOQ, and produce FATs, SATs, ITPs and related test documents, test certificates, acceptable to current NR (Network Rail) and other prevailing standards.
   

  

**Responsibility Includes;**
* Coordinate activities of subcontractors on project planning and especially with the civil works activities; report regularly to regional Telecom Engineering head and Project Management.
* Supervise and inspect all site telecommunications activities to ensure execution in accordance with the Project Schedule, Site Specific Work Plans, Approved Work Methods, Quality, Safety and Environmental Management Plans and Approved for Construction Drawings
* Perform field inspections to ensure compliance with the safety policies and procedures and approved work methods.
* Handover to commissioning using handover process/ documentation and support commissioning team to complete the testing phase.
* Analyze requirements and propose cost effective solutions to the track lead engineer.
* Ensure that the design is compatible with the standards of health \& safety,
* Coordinate with other entities (other ALSTOM activities/ civil work partners…) for the technical aspects of the interfaces and especially with the civil works.
* Technical open issues resolution on site, from investigation to modification implementation and problem closure,
* Support and coordinate the Telecom activities on site
* Ensure all design and solutions has been reviewed with Alstom Telecom engineering.
* Create/Support telecom architectures and solutions for project in terms of Alstom systems needed
* Ensure contact with the client and/or consortium representatives for the telecom sub\-system definition
* Ensure technology watch with the suppliers
* Assist the sourcing for telecom suppliers mapping and prepare compliance matrix for the supplier solutions.
* Ensure support on normative aspects
* Ensure design review application according to projects milestones
* Plan, execute, monitor and control Design, configuration, maintenance, test and Commissioning activities for the telecommunication system according to the overall program schedule.
* Interface with Customer and Engineers on design and commissioning status
* Maintain/Coordinate As\-Built Documentation submissions
* Deployment and sizing of networks (fiber optic transmission and other physical deployments (ODFs ..)
* Network maintenance and monitoring (protocol analyzers, performance indicators and quality of service),


**Qualification needed for this job?**
 In this role, you serves as the Project Company’s senior technical engineer and advisors for and in respect of all related work, services, tasks, activities and actions related to the Telecommunications Systems.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of network infrastructure (switches/routers/firewall/media convertor/etc,)
* Knowledge of associated protocols (TCP/IP, MPLS,LAN\-WAN), routing principles (static\&dynamic).
* CCNA \& CCNP certification is a plus
* Telecom Engineer, specialized with minimum 10 years\-experience in telecom subsystems and interfaces (experience railway systems is a plus).
* Good Communications and interpersonal skills including with third parties (client).
* Structured and organized with Hands\-on approach
* Extensive working knowledge of Complex Networks design, both wired and wireless
* Extensive experience with network architecture design
* Working knowledge of Switching and Routing protocols
* Working knowledge of wireless communications in demanding scenarios
* Prior experience managing medium\-large sized projects and project teams
* Working knowledge of Test and commissioning processes
* Detail oriented with organizational skills
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* Experience in the railway Signalling Systems sector would be a plus.


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

**Job Description**
 To provide clinical leadership for the Integrated Care Center (ICC), ensuring delivery of high\-quality, safe, and patient\-centered care. The Medical Director is accountable for clinical governance, physician performance, regulatory compliance, and alignment of clinical services with organizational goals, including quality outcomes, patient experience, and cost\-effective care.
   

  

**Clinical Leadership, Governance,**
**Accreditation \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Provide overall clinical leadership for the ICC clinical services and medical operations
* Enforce clinical policies, protocols, and standards of care
* Lead clinical governance meetings and medical committee activities in the center
* Oversee the credentialing and privileging process for all medical staff
* Ensure compliance with MOH KSA regulations and CBAHI accreditation standards
* Lead CBAHI accreditation preparation and audit activities for the center with collaboration with Medical Quality team
* Maintain up\-to\-date policies per CBAHI chapter standards.
* Respond to regulatory authority inquiries and inspection findings
* Ensure maintenance of accurate medical records and documentation standards


**Quality Improvement \& Patient Safety**
* Monitor clinical KPIs and quality indicators
* Lead root cause analysis for adverse events and near\-misses
* Implement evidence\-based clinical improvement initiatives
* Champion a culture of patient safety across all care team
* Oversee IPSG implementation and monitoring.


**Medical Staff Management**
* Lead center physician recruitment, onboarding, and retention processes
* Ensure that regular performance appraisals and competency assessments are conducted
* Manage physician scheduling and workload distribution
* Identify training needs for medical staff
* Handle medical staff disciplinary matters in line with HR policie


**Mmedical Staff Management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day clinical operations across the ICC clinic
* Ensure optimal patient flow and reduce wait times working with patient experience and service team
* Monitor adherence to clinical care pathways and referral protocols


**Strategic Planning \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Contribute to the strategic vision and business planning of the ICC clinic
* Represent the ICC in senior leadership discussions
* Build and maintain relationships with MOH, and external entities.
* Identify opportunities for new clinical services and program expansion
* Report clinical performance outcomes to senior management
* Any other duties assigned by Executive Director – Medical


**Clinical Duties (40%)**
* Deliver safe, evidence\-based, and patient\-centered clinical care within scope of specialty by conducting patient consultations, assessments, diagnosis, and treatment.

**Skills**
* Clinical leadership and decision making

* Excellent communication skills.
* High standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and governance.
* Risk management and problem solving
* Strong judgement, professionalism and ethical practice
* Excellent computer skills
* Fluent Arabic and English languages

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical QA/QC Engineer (Saudi National) to join our site supervision team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. As a key member of the quality assurance team, you will be responsible for ensuring that all construction activities comply with project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Implement and monitor Project Quality Plans, procedures, specifications, and Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs) for all construction activities
* Develop and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS), including procedures, guidelines, forms, data collection tools, reporting systems, and checklists to enhance performance and ensure compliance
* Plan, execute, and participate in internal and external quality audits, including supplier audits, and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions
* Monitor and assess project risks throughout the lifecycle, proactively addressing potential issues to prevent scope and quality deviations
* Supervise on\-site and off\-site construction activities, including mock\-ups, samples, and manufacturing processes (FAT/SAT)
* Lead change management initiatives for product quality improvements, ensuring effective implementation of new standards and processes
* Provide day\-to\-day support and guidance to project management teams and contractors on quality requirements and QMS implementation
* Lead regular quality surveillance and coordination meetings to drive continuous improvement
* Monitor and oversee contractors’ QMS implementation during project execution
* Conduct inspections and testing of construction activities, including excavation, formwork, reinforcement, concreting, structural works, masonry, and finishing
* Review and verify material test reports, mix designs, and calibration certificates
* Ensure all materials delivered to the site comply with approved material submittals and relevant standards
* Coordinate with clients and consultants on inspection requests and quality\-related matters
* Maintain and update quality control records, including inspection reports, test results, Site Observation Reports (SORs), and Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)
* Manage NCRs, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions using methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean principles
* Ensure construction practices comply with approved drawings, specifications, and method statements
* Assist in the review and approval of QA/QC documentation
* Ensure all activities comply with safety and environmental requirements
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and provide feedback for process optimization
* Analyze quality data to identify systemic issues and report on KPIs, PQIs, and dashboards
* Lead site walkthroughs, raise punch list items, and review handover documentation packages
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the Quality Manager, Program Director, and Client representatives


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
* Certification in ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management Systems) and ISO 19011:2018 (Audit Management)
* Licensed Civil Engineer (preferred)
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings and specifications
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Excellent communication and coordination abilities
* Experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* Expertise in non\-conformance reporting and implementing corrective actions
* Knowledge of construction materials testing methods
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail
* Ability to make sound and timely quality\-related decisions
* Collaborative approach to working with project teams and stakeholders

For more information, visit WPP.com
   

  

 For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
   

  

**More About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Riyadh\-based PR Group Account Director (or Account Director) to join our Destination, Sport, Entertainment \& Culture team. You will be responsible for driving strategic client relations, fostering robust media engagement across the Arabic media landscape, and providing exemplary leadership to your team.

* Extensive and demonstrable background in public relations within the destination, sport, entertainment, or culture sectors.
* Strong media relations expertise, with a particular focus on and established connections within the Arabic media landscape.
* Exceptional ability to develop and produce high\-quality Arabic content and compelling communication materials.
* Fully bilingual proficiency in both written and spoken Arabic and English is essential.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, with a track record of effectively guiding, mentoring, and overseeing PR teams.
* A strong portfolio showcasing successful strategic planning, integrated campaign management, and client relationship excellence.

Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a \#BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. **Job Title:** 
 HR Operations Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Position Overview**
**The HR Operations Manager** 
 will lead, and continuously improve all Human Resources Operations in Saudi Arabia. The role is responsible for ensuring that every aspect of the employee lifecycle is executed with precision, full legal compliance, and a high standard of service to both the business and its employees. The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, hands\-on experience with KSA government platforms, and the operational discipline to build structured HR processes in a dynamic, site\-based environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management
   

  

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end HR operations for MEP Contracting, Electrical Testing, and Facility Management divisions.
* Manage all onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring documentation accuracy, system entry into HRMS, and full compliance with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, contracts, and personnel files in both digital and physical formats.
* Coordinate inter\-project employee transfers and mobilization/demobilization processes in alignment with project timelines and management directives.


 Payroll Coordination \& Compensation Administration
   

  

* Gather, verify, and submit monthly payroll inputs — including attendance data, overtime, new hire additions, and terminations.
* Ensure strict compliance with the WPS and timely salary disbursement.
* Administer employee benefits including health insurance, annual leave entitlements, and End of Service Benefits (EOSB) calculations in accordance with Saudi Labor Law.
* Coordinate with the Group HR Director on compensation benchmarking and any salary structure updates.


 Government Relations \& Regulatory Compliance
   

  

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for all KSA government HR platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, Mudad, and HRSD.
* Manage Iqama renewals, work permit processing, and all government\-related employee documentation.
* Ensure full compliance with Saudi Labor Law (Articles 36 and 11 of Executive Regulations), Nitaqat/Saudization requirements, and all MHRSD directives.
* Monitor and act on Qiwa contract management, GOSI registration and contribution accuracy, and Muqeem residency status updates.
* Proactively track regulatory changes and update internal processes accordingly to prevent penalties and compliance failures.


 HR Policies, Procedures
   

  

* Implement and enforce Group HR policies and company specific procedures across all operational areas, including attendance management, leave administration, disciplinary processes, and code of conduct.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry and maintenance in HRMS, including employee master data, leave balances, and contract details.
* Prepare periodic HR reports and dashboards for management and the Group HR Director, covering headcount, turnover, leave utilization, and compliance status.
* Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risk.


 Employee Relations
   

  

* Act as the first point of contact for employees on all HR\-related queries, providing timely, accurate, and professional guidance.
* Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary cases, and labor disputes, in strict accordance with Saudi Labor Law and company policy.
* Support the implementation of employee engagement initiatives and contribute to building a positive, performance\-oriented work culture.


**Qualifications, Experience \& Competencies**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is required.
* Professional HR certification (CIPD Level 3/5, SHRM\-CP, or equivalent) is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive HR experience in Saudi Arabia, with at least 2–3 years in an HR operations or supervisory role.
* Prior experience in the engineering, construction, MEP contracting, or facilities management sector is strongly preferred, given the project\-based and site\-intensive nature of operations.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience managing KSA government platforms.
* Solid working knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, including leave entitlements, EOSB calculations, WPS compliance, and disciplinary procedures.
* Experience working with an HRMS platform.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and a process\-oriented mindset — accuracy in payroll and compliance data is non\-negotiable.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with employees at all levels.
* Analytical capability to prepare meaningful HR reports and identify trends.
* Proactive problem\-solver who can work independently and take ownership of the HR function.
* Professional fluency in Arabic and English — both written and spoken.


**Hiring Process**
 To ensure a fair, objective, and comprehensive selection process, all applications will go through the following structured stages:
   

  

* Initial Screening: A thorough evaluation of your CV, professional certificates, past experience, alignment with the required qualifications, and your responses to the application questionnaire.
* Online Assessment Center: Candidates who successfully pass the initial screening will be invited to complete an online assessment. This will evaluate cognitive abilities, functional HR skills, and personality traits to ensure a strong fit for the role and company culture.
* Interviews: Candidates who meet the success threshold based on the combined scores of the initial screening and the online assessment center will be invited to formal interviews with the HR leadership and management.

**Job Description**
**Title: HSE Manager**
**About ENGIE**
 ENGIE Group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
   

  

****Key activities and competencies****
**Strategic:**
* Develop a strategy for effective project occupational HSE management, including objectives, targets, and KPIs in line with ENGIE Group / AMEA HSE KPIs \& objectives.
* Collaborate with other departments to ensure compliance with Engie Group Rules (GRs) and develop AMEA\-specific HSE Standards.
* Develop both proactive and reactive HSE key performance indicators.


**Operational:**
* Provide HSE leadership and coordination to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and reduce the frequency and severity of adverse HSE events.
* Ensure consistent implementation of Project Company Health, Safety, and Environmental Standards during construction and commissioning up to COD and Operations.
* Maintain the Project Risk Register (HSE) and update it periodically based on actual risks.
* Manage high\-risk activities, including equipment logistics and lifting operations.
* Promote open and transparent Health, Safety, and Environmental reporting from the Project Company and Contractor(s) to AMEA Country HSE.
* Develop training, induction, and onboarding programs for Project Co. and contractors.


**Organisational:**
* Support the development of Engie HSE tools, procedures, and practices.
* Organise and participate in HSE campaigns and ensure contractor participation.
* Coordinate the design and delivery of HSE reports, presentations, and training programs.
* Support the HSE prequalification of contractors or subcontractors and assist in vendor selection.
* Monitor and measure Owners Engineer and contractor HSE performance.
* Conduct regular audits and site inspections to ensure contractor compliance with Project Company policies and procedures.
* Organise internal site peer reviews with recognized HSE experts.
* Manage the selection of third\-party auditors, consultants, and HSE contractors/practitioners
* Identify trends in Health and Safety performance and implement initiatives for improvement.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and maintain appropriate measurement, recording, and reporting systems.
* Develop robust emergency procedures and conduct regular drills.
* Support the development of HSE O\&M (Operational procedures review and validation).
* Facilitate internal and external benchmarking in construction HSE issues.
* Communicate lessons learned from other projects received from ENGIE and other sources.
* Manage relations with external partners on health, safety, and environmental issues (local authorities, equipment manufacturers, contractors, suppliers, etc.).


**Planning \& Delivery of Work:**
* Ensure HSE onboarding for everyone on the project through the Contractor.
* Oversee the development of comprehensive training programs for the workforce by Contractor(s).
* Assess and record the competency of HSE critical workforce.
* Implement and review a strict Construction Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).
* Implement and review a strict Commissioning Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).


**Decision Making:**
* Assess the effectiveness of risk management across the fleet and recommend actions for continuous improvement.
* Review and approve Project accident and incident investigations.
* Ensure proper and swift incident investigation to be performed by EPC contractors, including incidents occurring within subcontracted activities
* Assist and advise in the implementation of improvement and mitigation actions following incident investigations, ensure actions are closed and that lessons learned are circulated.
* Ability to work autonomously, prioritizing tasks and activities in line with business objectives.
* Ability to demonstrate support for innovation and for organizational changes, critical thinking.
* Maintains high ethical standards.


**Working with others:**
* Develop strong partnerships with the Project Construction Director, Country HSE Manager, other asset HSE teams, partners and external consultants where necessary.
* Work in coordination with the AMEA HSE network to enhance HSE awareness and engagement.
* Manage, mentor and develop your direct / indirect report in line with our People Development Strategy.
* Ability to work within a team of members from varying cultural backgrounds as well as with counterparts of varying cultural backgrounds.
* Able to work in a multicultural environment and with multidisciplinary teams
* Strong leadership abilities to engage people proactively to work towards project Safety Culture.
* Presence and interpersonal credibility to represent the Project Company with key stakeholders, JV partners and external organisations, Government representatives, Local \& national agencies.


****Key relationships****
 Internal:
   

  

* Project Company Management team, Employees, Owner Engineering team, Contractors \& Subcontractors
* Head of HSE RGBU AMEA
* Engie Group HSE
* internal Stakeholders representatives \& visitors
* Lenders Engineer and other internal inspectors / auditors.
* Assigned Medical service Provider(s)
* International SOS agency (ENGIE)


 External:
   

  

* Partner’s Representatives
* External consultants
* Government Regulatory authorities, Environmental inspection agencies.
* Local security agencies, police, emergency medical organisations.
* Local Communities (indirect).
* Other external Stakeholders and relevant parties including NGO’s (indirect).


****Required Qualifications****
 Qualifications:
   

  

* Recognised Engineering or science qualification
* Internationally recognized Safety and Health qualification (NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent as a minimum).
* Accreditations preferred for Fire \& Risk management, Advanced First Aid, Confined Spaces, Emergency Response Rescue, Heavy Equipment inspection, scaffolding management.


 Experience:
   

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience managing Health, Safety, Environment Projects as a Manager within the Power Generation Industry:
* Power generation technology including renewables (Solar project experience preferred)
* Water desalination and chemical treatment systems.
* Civil, mechanical and construction activities.
* Successful HSE track record within construction and commissioning of large\-scale Projects. (\>1 BUSD)
* Professional experience working in Remote Project locations in hardship environments.
* In depth understanding for implementing management systems such as ISO:45001 and ISO:14001\.
* Professional experience in managing HSE within a culturally diverse workforce and local population and other sensitive receptors (Stakeholder engagement \& management).
* Experience in Project Ethical standards, Welfare, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with strict Environmental sensitive receptors and cultural heritage Management.
* Experience in Safety Management of complex Logistical mobilization of equipment \& resources over long distances.
* Experience in Overall Project Risk Register and Risk Mitigation Management.
* Experience in management Project Emergency Response Planning, in particular medical emergencies.
* Understanding in the application of International Standards (NFPA, ISO, OSHAD, etc.) as needed.
* Professional H\&S experience for complex construction activities including heavy lifting operations.


 Knowledge and Skills:
   

  

* High Proficiency in English (verbal and written), Hindi / Urdu, Arabic desirable but not essential.
* High level of HSE technical knowledge and understanding of Process Safety Management.
* Excellent communication, training, and presentation skills.
* High level of data analysis skills and experience in audit, inspection, and report writing.
* MS Office \& Social Media applications
* Proficiency utilising Noise monitoring, Atmospheric Gas testing, and environmental monitoring devices.


 Business Unit: GBU Renewables \& Flexible Power
   

  

 Division: GEN International \- KSA
   

  

 Legal Entity: ENGIE Regional Headquarters LLC
   

  

 Professional Experience: Skilled ( \>3 experience \<15 years)
   

  

 Education Level: Bachelor's Degree

data.jd_text:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Upgrades \& deployments: oversee the dedicated Upgrade and Deployment team (consisting of 4 personnel) responsible for executing software patching, rollbacks, updates, and deployment across all lab and production systems.
* Performance monitoring \&reporting: direct the KPI Reporting \& Analytics team to generate comprehensive system performance reports, Kodiak Analytic reports, and drive test reports to ensure service quality and SLA compliance.
* Testing \& verification: oversee change management verification, Wave mobile application acceptance testing, and drive testing operations (in coordination with 3rd party vendors).
* Knowledge transfer \& enablement: manage the Knowledge Transfer lead to facilitate comprehensive user engagement, onboarding, fleet mapping preparation, and continuous training development for the customer.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with the Customer Support Manager (CSM), Incident Managers, and supporting functions (like HR, Commercial, and Procurement) to align strategic goals and ensure continuous service improvement.


**Required Operating Environment Context**
 The role supports a 24x7x365 support model handling highly complex, mission\-critical push\-to\-talk (MCPTT) applications.
   

  

 The candidate will be subject to local Saudization requirements, which may require specific educational degrees related to the role to be granted a work permit.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

* Take part in the formulation of standard procedures regarding service delivery.
* Lead the transition and transformation of project operations to Managed Services.
* Ensure that procedures and plans formulated for the customer are in line with the organization’s goals.
* Ensure that procedures formulated are fully implemented to achieve service level objectives.
* Attend important meetings on behalf of the service delivery team or appoint representatives.
* Make recommendations for changes to technology or procedures for the customer.
* Prepare periodic reports and present such reports to the customer stakeholders.
* Analysis of system performance and facilitate improvement recommendations.


 Cost and Efficiency
   

  

 A common fiscal responsibility of the Service Delivery Manager is to ensure delivery processes are efficient and cost effective. To reduce costs and streamline the process without adversely impacting the client experience, they might eliminate paperwork, unnecessary service steps or non\-value\-added features. For technology service providers, an emphasis should be placed on the efficient delivery of hardware and software services.
   

  

* Suggest new strategies to maintain or improve on the quality of service delivery \& minimize cost.
* Carry out research regularly and attend seminars to learn improved service delivery procedures and processes.


 Customer Satisfaction
   

  

 A key role for the service delivery manager is to constantly assess customer feedback and make necessary improvements. Managers typically conduct evaluations with customers on the phone, in person, via e\-mail or through postal mail. When scores fall below the preset thresholds, the manager may conduct additional research and take steps to correct deficiencies. For example, some customers might feel like parts of the process are slow or delayed. By identifying and analyzing the issues, the service delivery manager can work on eliminating bottlenecks.
   

  

* Collect data and information on client satisfaction, inquiry, and complaint.
* Plan, manage and execute customer meetings for service delivery reporting and improvements.
* He/she will ensure that clients’ satisfaction is always guaranteed and will consistently collate data on customer satisfaction, inquiry and complaint.
* Responsible for maintaining a positive relationship with customers.
* identifying customer needs and ensuring that the service provider is able to meet these needs with an appropriate catalogue of services.
* The Service Delivery Manager has responsibility for being the Customer’s advocate within Motorola and being Motorola’s face to the Customer.
* Support the customer to best use the features and deliverables of Managed Service.
* Performs analysis of issues and problems.
* Lead efforts to escalate across internal functional groups to resolve service or client business impacting issues.
* Provides support relative to contractual commitments and SLA's.


 Management
   

  

* Educate the members of the service delivery team on new plans and implication on service delivery.
* Assess the individual and collective performance of the team members.
* Organize and head meetings with the service delivery team.
* Responsible for training of service delivery resources.
* Reporting.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

* Diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical) or related discipline
* ITIL v4 certification
* High level of understanding of Communication systems and IP Networks
* 2\+ years experience with planning and transitioning a project to operations and maintenance phase
* 5\+ years experience managing a service delivery team, ideally focused on operations and maintenance
* High\-level experience in telecoms or public safety
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and presentation in English and Arabic)
* Excellent customer service skills with a focus on Total Customer Satisfaction
* Effective consultation and liaison skills
* Good planning and time management skills
* Ability to prioritise, multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent theoretical and practical problem\-solving skills
* Well\-developed interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Ability to work unsupervised
* Technical literacy


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 25\-50%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 Domestic
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No
   

  

**Company**
 Motorola Solutions Arabia, Inc., Saudi Branch
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
