**Job Description**

 The Commissioning Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery with regards to Testing and Commissioning from design to Level 5 plus handover on behalf of the Client. The Commissioning Manager will be able to manage a very fast, diverse, and rapidly changing programmes, across potentially multiple projects at different stages.
   

  

 It is expected that the Commissioning Manager will have the gravitas to successfully influence at all levels across both internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





  

  




* Responsible for establishing and managing the programme wide commissioning plan and processes, aligned with the Clients and End\-User requirements and standards.
* Coordinate commissioning scope, commissioning levels (L1–L5\), milestones, and success criteria for all systems. In accordance with the Clients and End\-User’s requirements.
* Participate in design reviews in relation to address commissioning requirements and oversee integration into design deliverables.
* Oversee and direct the appointed CxAs to promote consistent execution of commissioning activities across all project phases/ projects.
* Work closely with commissioning agents, construction teams, and OEMs to align the design with commissioning requirements, address commissioning‑driven design issues, and incorporate red‑lines and test outcomes into the final as‑built design.
* Undertake a review of the CxA commissioning documentation, scripts, procedures and test reports to support clarity, completeness, and alignment with project requirements.
* Monitor CxA performance against programme, quality requirements, and contract deliverables.
* Facilitate coordination between CxAs, contractors, OEMs, design teams, and operations stakeholders.
* Oversee safe, controlled execution of commissioning activities in line with the project programme.
* Lead commissioning meetings, workshops, and readiness reviews (L0/L1 readiness, Pre‑FAT, FAT, SAT, IST).
* Drive early engagement with equipment vendors and contractors to confirm commissioning readiness.
* Oversee integrated testing of critical systems such as electrical power systems, cooling infrastructure, BMS/EPMS, fire protection, ICT and security systems.
* Validate that issues identified during commissioning are tracked, resolved, and closed.
* Oversee commissioning activities to promote compliance with applicable codes, standards, and best practices (ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, IEEE, etc.).
* Support commissioning teams by ensuring design intent is clearly reflected in commissioning scripts and test procedures.
* Maintain complete commissioning records including documentation, test results, redlines, checklists, and as‑built updates.
* Review system performance information to support assessment of how well systems align with performance, uptime and resiliency expectations.
* Coordinate handover activities with Operations/Facilities teams to facilitate a smooth transition to production.
* Support training, O\&M documentation review, and readiness of the operations team.
* Provide technical expertise and act as a client representative during testing and close out.
* Manage the commissioning programme in alignment with the overall project schedule.
* Identify commissioning risks and implement/ lead mitigation strategies early.
* Provide accurate forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.
* Provide regular T\&C updates/status to senior leadership with any potential issues and solutions to avoid impact on programme.
* Provide strategic advice to senior leadership in regard to T\&C processes, methodologies, plans, execution.
* Provide support and work closely with the portfolio\-wide PMO team during execution of the Clients projects.
* Facilitate lessons learned documents from each project to assist in the development of internal commissioning policies / processes. Commissioning Manager
* Support and provide input and advice during procurement of the Client’s delivery partners (contractors, consultants, CxA etc.). Including development of scope of works / scope of services / employer’s requirements from a T\&C aspect, responding to tender queries and all\-round T\&C technical support.

* Recognised Project Management qualifications are advantageous.

**Skills and behaviours**



* Minimum of 8 years’ experience
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Testing and Commissioning management

* Experienced in Client facing role
* Strong understanding of data centre testing and commissioning L1\-L5
* Demonstrate experience delivering commissioning across all levels (L1\-L5\)
* Deep knowledge of data centre design principles, including redundancy strategies, thermal management, electrical resilience, and Uptime Institute Tier concepts

* Understanding of relevant codes and regulations
* Proficiency in commissioning software/tools, reporting platforms, and standard office applications

* The post holder will be based in our office location in Qatar, or on our client site office

data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 NUQ Library
   

  

 Northwestern University in Qatar (NU\-Q) seeks an outstanding Director of the NU\-Q Library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library guides a team of library professionals with vision and purpose in support of NU\-Q vision of excellence in teaching, research, and mediamaking. Reporting to the Associate Dean for Education, the Director of the NU\-Q Library will provide collaborative leadership and strategic direction to the programs, services, initiatives, and collections of the NU\-Q Library. The successful candidate will be a forward\-thinking professional who is enthusiastic about advancing research, teaching, learning, and practice through access to NU\-Q Library resources, and knowledgeable about the complex nature of building, supervising, managing, and mentoring a collaborative team. The Director of the NU\-Q Library will facilitate partnerships in education and knowledge creation within Northwestern and beyond.
   

  

**Core Mission**
* Commitment to the core mission of NU\-Q as a global community of evidence\-based storytellers guided by the core values of excellence, collaboration, community, and sustainability
* Leadership and Strategic Vision
* Administration and Supervision
* Campus Engagement
* Professional and Ethical Practices and Innovation
* Assessment and Continuous Improvement


 The NU\-Q Library is a user\-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU\-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu\-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. The NU\-Q Library’s core mission is to coordinate and deliver robust reference services both in\-person and online, supporting research and learning across disciplines.
   

  

 The Director of the NU\-Q Library supports the university leadership and is responsible for the overall management and administration of the NU\-Q library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library oversees all aspects of NU\-Q Library staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment. With a keen eye on strategic planning and strategic resource management, the Director of the NU\-Q Library develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence. As a passionate advocate for the NU\-Q Library's core mission and services, the Director of the NU\-Q Library builds strong relationships with campus leadership and stakeholders, championing the library's essential role in academic excellence and student success. Through thoughtful planning and continuous assessment, the Director of the NU\-Q Library drives the development of innovative research support services and information resources. By partnering with faculty, academic departments, and student support teams, the Director of the NU\-Q Library helps elevate community members’ learning outcomes and ensures the library remains a vital, evolving hub of intellectual engagement. The Director of the NU\-Q Library fosters a culture of shared governance; advances the library culture of assessment through data collection; engages in evidence\-based decision\-making practices; and promotes a culture of accessibility, accountability, innovation, and ethical practices.
   

  

 There are also opportunities to collaborate with NU\-Q’s Institute for Advanced Study of the Global South (IAS), Artificial Intelligence and Media Lab (AIM\-Lab), and Media Majlis Museum (MMM). The IAS in the Global South at NU\-Q (\#IAS\_NUQ) produces and promotes evidence\-based storytelling focused on the histories, cultures, societies, and media of the Global South. The AIM\-LAB at NU\-Q produces and promotes data\-based storytelling focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence and media. MMM at NU\-Q is a museum dedicated to exploring journalism, communication, media and art.
   

  

 In the era of digital technologies and AI, libraries in media schools need to transition from a conventional resource center into an active catalyst for digital storytelling, research advancement, and ethical media innovation. They curate and provide access to multimedia collections, data journalism resources, AI\-driven production tools, and cutting\-edge media technologies. Beyond access, libraries in media schools are expected to cultivate advanced information literacy, AI literacy, critical understanding of algorithms, copyright compliance, academic integrity, and responsible AI integration in creative projects. They partner with faculty, staff, and students to confront misinformation, deepfakes, and data ethics challenges while upholding the highest standards of media research, media production, journalism practice, and creative scholarship.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in a subject area relevant to the core mission of Northwestern University in Qatar (communication studies, media studies, media design, cinema studies, journalism studies, liberal arts, etc.)


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) from an ALA\-accredited program.
* Minimum of 6 years of successful progressive leadership experience in university libraries (e.g., Assistant Director of Library and then Associate Director of Library required to support the Director of Library).
* Proven experience in and strong record of supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating librarian faculty and staff members, fostering professional growth, contribution, and collaboration
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing and delivering library faculty/staff development programs
* Proven experience in and strong record of annual assessment of library services and implementation of long\-term strategies for the growth and innovation of library services
* Proven experience in and strong record of data collection and data analytics to inform evidence\-based decision\-making and service improvements
* Proven experience in and strong record of assessment of the effectiveness of library services, spaces, and collections in advancing student success and academic excellence
* Proven experience in and strong record of adoption of emerging technologies and innovative practices to enhance access, discovery, and research support
* Proven experience in and strong record of development and implementation of strategic initiatives that support institutional goals and accreditation requirements
* Proven experience in and strong record of university teaching and instructional design for information literacy
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing programs that showcase the role of university libraries in research, curricular use, and community engagement
* Proven experience in strategic planning, assessment practices, and advocacy in higher education environments.
* Proven experience in and strong record of building and maintaining effective partnerships and collaborations between the library, university leadership, academic departments, and the broader university community
* Proven experience in and strong record of dedication to student success
* Solid understanding of the organizational structure, organizational workflows, and approval chains in top\-tier universities
* Extensive knowledge of a broad range of issues and emerging trends in managing, collecting, and providing access to academic/university libraries
* Knowledge of Open Education Resources (OER) and affordable learning initiatives
* Comprehensive familiarity with the current trends in academic libraries, media schools, digital scholarship, and student learning support.
* Proven experience in budget and grant development and management
* Excellent communication, collaborative, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Strong record of professional engagement and contribution, such as research, publications, and involvement in professional and scholarly organizations
* Strong record of progressively responsible experience working with a multidisciplinary team in academic/university libraries, including supervisory and leadership roles.
* Proven experience in and strong interest in applying new and emerging technologies to Library collections and archives, including digital scholarship and digital humanities initiatives
* Ability to demonstrate a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor when working with a variety of situations and/or people.
* Vision for leveraging emerging technologies, including the ethical application and use of artificial intelligence for library resources, services, and assessment
* Experience with collection development and maintenance, including databases and resources


***Please note this position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.***
**Responsibilities**
* Provide leadership to and management of a forward\-thinking NU\-Q Library, by playing a dynamic leadership role, guiding a team of library professionals with vision and purpose
* Oversee all aspects of staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment
* With a keen eye on strategic resource management, the Director develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence.
* Articulate a compelling vision for the NU\-Q Library and the value of the NU\-Q Library in supporting research, teaching, learning, and community engagement that aligns with the NU\-Q Library’s core mission and strategic directions
* Provide vision for NU\-Q Library collection development and stewardship. Establish priorities and develop policies that guide the development of library collections in alignment with the core mission of NU\-Q
* Establish strategic directions and priorities for a range of user\-centered services and programs that create exceptional experiences for the Northwestern community in support of their research, teaching, learning and practice with NU\-Q Library resources
* Provide leadership and oversight to the development of staff development programs and initiatives that establish the NU\-Q Library as a dynamic and innovative teaching and learning resource at Northwestern
* Provide overall direction for a team of 7 librarian faculty and staff members. Directly supervise Library faculty/staff members including librarians, library associate, and library assistants. Coordinate the department work. Provide mentorship, advocacy and support to all department staff and foster their professional engagement and growth
* Build and nurture collaborations and partnerships within the library, with faculty, academic departments, and the broader Northwestern community that strengthen and promote the key role and core mission of the NU\-Q Library in research, teaching, and community engagement
* Collaborate with library departments to advance the library’s digital transformation agenda to broaden discovery, access, and preservation of primary source materials in support of research and academic pursuits
* Represent the NU\-Q library in initiatives and events related to the strategic vision and priorities of the university within and outside NU\-Q. Contribute to the library’s leadership role in the field through projects, presentations, scholarship, and active participation in relevant professional organizations


**The anticipated salary range is $100,000 – $110,000 Commensurate with experience and qualifications.** 
 The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.
   

  

 NU\-Q is a community of evidence\-based storytellers in the Global South. We are a globally embedded institution, being one of three campuses of Northwestern University (Chicago, Doha, Evanston) and one of several partner universities in the Qatar Foundation’s Education City in Doha, Qatar. data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for a Deputy Director – Food Operations to fully own the operational performance of our Food vertical.
   

  

 This is a standalone, high\-impact role focused on execution, optimization, and profitability. You will work directly with the COO to translate strategy into disciplined operational outcomes. Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.
* Food Vertical Performance \& Unit Economics
* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuously optimize supply\-demand balance in dense operating environments.
* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.
* Restaurant Operations \& Partner Success
* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.
* Leverage demand forecasting, cohort analysis, and behavioural data to identify growth and efficiency levers. When metrics shift, you understand why — and you act decisively.


**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
* 10\+ years of operational experience, with at least 5–7 years in food delivery, high\-frequency platforms, or tech\-enabled logistics environments.
* Experience in dense, highly competitive markets is essential.
* Background in logistics, food operations, commercial strategy, or product operations within leading global platforms is strongly preferred. You must understand supply\-demand balance, incentive systems, batching logic, dispatch optimization, and unit economics at a structural level.
* Strong analytical capability is mandatory. Exposure to BI tools, SQL, and performance dashboarding is expected. MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.

data.jd_text:
Syntys is a leading data center provider specializing in the design, construction, and management of data centers, catering to hyperscalers, AI infrastructure, and colocation wholesale providers across the MENA region. With presence in more countries than any other provider in the region, Syntys is committed to delivering scalable, secure, and efficient digital infrastructure solutions.
 



  





 As a Senior Construction Project Manager (Data Centers), you will step into a pivotal client\-side leadership role, seamlessly integrating with executive teams to drive massive\-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion. This isn't just about managing timelines; it’s about strategic governance. You will take full ownership of the project lifecycle—managing program, cost, and exceptional quality standards—while effortlessly bridging the communication gap between key project stakeholders and the PMC. If you have a proven track record of steering complex data center builds to successful conclusions, we want you at the helm.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* **Strategic Governance:** 
 Provide overarching leadership to set up project teams, establish robust controls, implement quality standards, and offer critical buildability and technical advice.
* **Communication \& Liaison:** 
 Serve as the central focal point and strategic "filter" between the Client, consultants, and contractors to ensure fast, transparent, and effective information flow.
* **Risk \& Change Control:** 
 Proactively monitor the project Risk Plan (contingency and drawdowns) and rigorously manage the Change Control system.
* **Design Management:** 
 Facilitate design team/contractor procurement (including bid and contract placement) and manage the design process to ensure flawless execution of client requirements.
* **Site Operations:** 
 Oversee the release of timely CAIs (Confirmation of Architect's Instructions) with actionable build data, and strictly manage the coordination of Health \& Safety issues.
* **Financial Oversight:** 
 Manage construction budgets with a sharp focus on cost control, providing weekly financial updates, variance tracking, and risk/opportunity logs to senior leadership.
* **Milestone Tracking:** 
 Formalize and track detailed delivery programmes, paying critical attention to high\-level milestones, enabling works, and specialized sequences (e.g., BMS \& Commissioning).
* **Meeting Architecture:** 
 Establish and chair a structured cadence of meetings, including weekly client project/design meetings, fortnightly change control updates, and coordination/Value Engineering workshops.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Act as the bridge between specialized project tracks, maintaining close liaison with move teams, security, maintenance, IT, AV, and end\-users.
* **Contract Completion:** 
 Formally verify that all works are completed in strict accordance with contract parameters and manage the design team's snagging/de\-snagging process.
* **Documentation \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure full compilation of O\&M manuals, Health \& Safety files, and all necessary witnessing/testing documentation.



  





**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications \& Experience):**



* **Degree:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluency in
 **English** 
 is required;
 **Arabic** 
 language capability is a strong advantage.
* **Industry Veteran:** 
 Minimum of
 **10\+ years** 
 of construction management experience, with at least
 **5 years** 
 dedicated to data center construction or complex technology infrastructure projects.
* **Full\-Lifecycle Mastery:** 
 A proven track record of steering large\-scale projects through all phases: design, construction, and commissioning (Cx).
* **Critical Environments:** 
 Deep technical understanding of data center infrastructure, including cooling systems, critical power, fire suppression, and security systems.
* **Hyperscale \& Colocation:** 
 Direct experience working with hyperscalers or managing complex colocation facility builds.
* **Project Controls:** 
 Strong proficiency in contract administration and a solid understanding of Primavera P6 schedules.
* **Compliance \& Standards:** 
 Sharp knowledge of building codes, environmental regulations, and rigid health and safety compliance for high\-tech, high\-availability facilities.

data.jd_text:
**Data Centre, Technical \& Engineering Director** 




**Doha, Qatar** 




  





  






 Position Overview:
 




  





 The Technical \& Engineering Director position will be working within the businesses EPC Power \& Digital division, on all MENA data centre project.
 



  





 The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data centre projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



  





 Working in close alignment with the EPC Chief Operations Officer the Technical \& Engineering Director serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





 Some travel to construction sites across MENA will be required when necessary.
 



  






 Key Responsibilities:
 




  




* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)
* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants
* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections
* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework
* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements
* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements
* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off
* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers



  






 Qualifications \& Experience
 




  




* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data centre projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data centre projects
* Deep working knowledge of data centre power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets
* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)



  





 This is a full time, 5 days\-a\-week head office position in Doha, Qatar.

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 The Project Engineering Manager is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering framework for project execution, ensuring the effective delivery of multi\-disciplinary engineering and design activities across our offshore projects in Energy and hydrocarbon sectors.
   

  

**Specific Accountabilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Execution**
* Establish and implement the project engineering execution framework, including procedures, deliverables, workflows, and interface management.
* Lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across Feasibility/ Concept, FEED and Detailed Design phases.
* Direct the preparation and quality of engineering deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, standards, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant design output, meeting customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Review and approve engineering execution strategies, project organization structures, and discipline responsibilities.
* Prepare and implement the Engineering management Plan on projects and ensure discipline schedules/budgets include safety and sustainability activities for the asset lifecycle.
* Manage technical Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) \- technology selection, value engineering, energy optimization, RAM, etc.


**Cross\-Discipline Coordination \& Interface Management**
* Provide overall integration across engineering disciplines, ensuring effective sequencing and interface management.
* Establish and maintain engineering coordination procedures with internal teams, licensors, contractors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee and manage interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, and third\-party contractors.
* Ensure structured communication and resolution of technical queries and inter\-disciplinary conflicts.


**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure engineering activities comply with Worley standards, international codes, and customer specifications
* Must ensure maintaining engineering quality assurance processes, including document control, review cycles, and approval timelines.
* Lead the review and approval of key engineering documents, ensuring compliance with HSSEQ, operability, maintainability, and technical integrity requirements.
* Must ensure and participate in design reviews, safety studies, and technical assurance activities.
* Ensure required Technical Peer Reviews (TPRs) are planned, scheduled, and budgeted; proactively engage Location Director of Engineering when needed.


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Overall key technical interface with customer management teams.
* Support the safe, on\-time, and within\-budget delivery of engineering scope across all project phases.
* Monitor engineering progress against schedule, budget, and deliverable milestones, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
* Provide technical and commercial input to optimize design solutions and manage project risks.
* Ensure alignment between engineering outputs and project controls (cost, schedule, procurement needs).
* Maintain engineering registers for assumptions, holds, technical queries, deviations, key document changes, and SEAL decisions.


**HSSEQ \& Compliance**
* Champion Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality culture within engineering activities.
* Ensure designs incorporate safe, sustainable, and environmentally compliant solutions.
* Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory frameworks and standards.


**Team Leadership \& Capability**
* Lead, mentor, and develop multi\-location engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and competency.
* Ensure teams are appropriately staffed and aligned with project requirements.
* Foster collaboration across disciplines, offices, and stakeholders.
* Capture and implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Education**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline of Engineering from an accredited University.
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.
* MME (Ministry of Municipality and Environment) engineering accreditation is a mandatory requirement. Candidates not holding this accreditation must be willing to achieve this within the probationary period.


**Job Specific Knowledge , Experience \& Competencies**
* Significant experience in oil \& gas, petrochemical, or energy sector projects.
* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance.
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing.
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processes.
* Solid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC).
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications.
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making.


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams.
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities.
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline.
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**About KPMG Qatar** 




 KPMG has had a presence in Qatar for nearly 47 years. We opened for business in Qatar in 1977 and are now one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the country.

Our services are focused on the Finance Function, and we work with clients in identifying and tackling their challenges in Growth, Governance and Performance. Our Advisory teams support businesses as they restructure and expand, whether organically or by acquisition. We help them to become more efficient and provide support as they adapt to the challenges posed by a rapidly changing business environment

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Emiri Decision No13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST has over 70 bachelor's and master's degree programs, diplomas, and certificates. The university houses 5 colleges: The College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, in addition to specialized training centers for individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Its world\-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well\-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.
   

  

 With more than 700 staff and over 8,000 students, UDST is the destination of choice for applied and experiential learning. The University is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Our faculty are committed to delivering pedagogically\-sound learning experiences that incorporate innovative learning technologies. Our aim is to enhance students’ skills and help develop talented graduates who can effectively contribute to a knowledge\-based economy and make Qatar’s National Vision 2030 a reality.
   

  

 Our eligible employees enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, in accordance with applicable UDST policies. These benefits include:
   

  

* Generous academic annual leave
* Tax free salary
* Fully furnished upmarket accommodation (inclusive of utilities: water \& electricity)
* Annual flights for spouse and 3 children (up to 18 years old)
* Children’s education allowance
* Relocation/Shipping allowance
* Professional development opportunities
* International health insurance
* In\-house immigration services (to help you through the residency process)
* Full access to our recreational facilities
* Research and professional development support.


 The College of Health Sciences invites applications for Midwifery faculty at Lecturer rank.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Applicants must meet all essential qualifications in order to be shortlisted for the position; other qualifications may be a deciding factor in selection. Qualifications and experience will be assessed through your application, which may include but not be limited to curricula vitae, cover letters, references, teaching dossiers and sample publications. It is the applicant’s responsibility to provide appropriate examples that illustrate how s/he meets each requirement. Failing to do so could result in the application being rejected. We thank all applicants for applying for the role; only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Your Commitment**
 Reporting to the Department Head, the successful candidate will be responsible for the development, delivery and evaluation of a broad range of courses within the midwifery domain. She will evaluate student progress and manage the resources of the learning environment. The successful candidate will liaise with industry and other educational institutions; participate in industry advisory committees and coordinate, manage and control projects within the specified program area. Faculty members will keep course portfolio documents required for accreditation processes and engage in instructional development/improvement plans. All employees are expected to contribute to professional and community life within the University and beyond.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience Requirements**
 Faculty members will be placed in the appropriate rank based on their education and experience. The broad criteria are noted below.
   

  

**Education**
* A Master’s in Midwifery is preferred.
* All candidates must hold registration as a registered midwife and be in good standing with the regulatory body.


**Experience**
* Preference given to those with experience teaching midwifery practice in a post\-secondary institution and/or mentoring/precepting midwifery students during practice practicums.
* Master’s prepared candidates must have a minimum of Three (3\) years full\-time equivalent to recent clinical practice experience
* Undergraduate prepared candidates must have a minimum of five (5\) years full\-time equivalent to recent clinical practice experience.
* Demonstrate the ability to use diverse and current teaching approaches for practice, experiences including the laboratory, simulation, and practicums.
* Demonstrate academic and information literacy skills.


**Scholarship and Research**
* Demonstrated aptitude for scholarship that contributes to the advancement of teaching and learning of midwifery practice.
* Demonstrated aptitude to use a variety of educational technology and platforms.


**Other Required Skills**
* Commitment to applied and experiential learning as a pedagogy and a key feature of UDST’s mandate.
* Ability to design, develop, deliver, and evaluate authentic learning experiences and assessments incorporating contemporary tools and resources to maximize content learning in context and to develop the knowledge, skills, and attitudes identified in program outcomes.
* Digital literacy and demonstrated fluency in technology systems, and an ability to model and facilitate use of current and emerging digital tools to support research and learning.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technology\-enriched learning environments that enable students to be active participants in their own learning.
* Commitment to the effectiveness, vitality, and self\-renewal of the teaching profession through self\-driven continuous professional development and life\-long learning.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.
* Collaborative and collegial spirit and a demonstrated ability to establish rapport with learners, colleagues, sponsor\-employers, and members of the community.
* Experience in leadership and innovation in technology\-based projects.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Faculty of English**
**Compass International School Doha, Qatar**
 Compass was established in 2006 to provide a premium British education to both expatriate and local Qatari families. We have three campuses; Al Themaid and Madinat Khalifa educate students from Early Years through to Secondary whereas Gharaffa is a stand\-alone Primary campus for children aged 3\-11\. All campuses offer a bespoke British curriculum. Secondary students can select from a wide range of IGSEs, AS and A levels. Additionally, we offer the prestigious IB Diploma Programme in Years 12 and 13\. All three sites offer a warm, friendly learning environment with our students at the heart of everything we do. We are proud of our outstanding teachers and our community feel. As for Qatar, a sunny climate year\-round and an airport with fantastic global connections ensures the continued popularity of this destination for expats.
   

  

 Our school has Qatar National Schools Accreditation (QNSA) and is a member of the British Schools in the Middle East (BSME), COBIS and AoBSO.
   

  

 To learn more about our school, please visit our website
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Faculty. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at Compass. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of faculty performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the faculty will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following essential attributes:
   

  

  

* 
+ university degree in a relevant specialist subject
+ teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
+ teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
+ strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* 
+ Job purpose
+ Reporting to
+ Key relationships
+ Key results areas
+ Performance measurement


**Benefits**
 Nord Anglia Education is the world's leading premium schools organisation. We are a fast\-paced and growing family of 80\+ international schools in China, Europe, the Middle East, South\-East Asia and The Americas, providing outstanding education to over 90,000 students from preschool to 18 years of age. Our schools are united by one philosophy\-we are ambitious for our students, our people, our community and family of schools. This means that we want every student to achieve more in our schools, than in any other schools in the world. We ensure this through personalised learning enhanced with bespoke global opportunities such as Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. We learn from the best and with the best.
   

  

 We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in a rapidly growing country which is perhaps best known for successfully hosting the World Cup in 2022\. Qatar is a great place to be based for travel and enjoys a lovely climate most of the year.
   

  

**Essential**
**Experience / Qualifications Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ A university degree in English or a related subject
+ A teaching qualification (QTS)
+ At least 5 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum


**Desirable** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
+ Master's degree, or other significant professional development
+ Previous international experience


**Personal Qualities Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Fluent English speaker
+ Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
+ Reliability, loyalty and commitment
+ Personal confidence and presence
+ Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do' approach
+ Strong interpersonal skills
+ Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
+ Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
+ Sense of humour and grace under pressure
+ Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
+ Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
+ Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
+ Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 The application should be submitted online via the Nord Anglia Education Careers page.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application, and the details of three professional references, one of which should be a School Principal.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 1st August 2025
   

  

 The closing date for applications is
 **30th June 2026\.**
**Selection process**
 Interviews will be conducted face to face or via Teams.
   

  

 Candidates are encouraged to apply early as the school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date.
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.

**About Commercial Bank**
 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Working closely with the Head of Wealth Management and Head of Wealth Products, this role is responsible for management of existing suite of wealth products and customer portfolio. Additionally, it involves ongoing innovative enhancement of the Wealth Management CVP across different segments of customers. This would include internal product development, research, third\-party product supplier management, product pricing and maintenance from concept through to full delivery to market. In addition, the role will require continuous interaction with multiple internal and external stakeholders across the Bank to ensure seamless functioning of the business and achievement of financial and non\-financial KPIs.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Responsible for supporting the Wealth business strategy and implementation of underlying business objectives across product, process, people and platforms to drive growth in client\-base, revenue and assets under management (AUM).
* End to end management of structured solutions portfolio including but not limited to product development, structuring, pricing, marketing and seamless execution with key issuer partners.
* Contribute to the preparation of financial targets using scientific approach involving portfolio analytics, performance trends and growth expectations. Modelling and structuring of internal incentive campaigns to drive frontline motivation while managing acquisition cost within allocated budgets.
* Regularly monitor financial performance versus the budget, in order to ensure that any improvement areas are quickly identified and addressed.
* Develop and enhance organizational skillset by training Wealth Advisors and frontline teams on Wealth Management fundamentals and latest investment offerings.
* Regularly engaging with third party asset managers to ensure that Wealth Management proposition remains highly competitive in terms of pricing, risk diversification and in line with international market trends and best practices.
* Provide periodic and / or ad hoc reports and analysis for Retail leadership to track portfolio performance and productivity.
* Work towards implementation of digital solutions leading to better controls, streamlined execution and ensuring that all activities are conducted in compliance with risk, audit, and regulatory requirements while delivering a quality, cost\-effective service.
* Periodic engagements with Wealth Management clients and other current and future market participants to deliver sessions focus on financial education and empowerment.
* Development and execution of marketing campaigns focused on market education and enhancement of client acquisition through communicating key aspects of the Wealth Management CVP.
* Ensuring suitable processes and controls are in place in order to comply with regulations and Banks procedures and mitigate financial, operational and reputational risks


****Key Competencies****
* Drive for results/ Achievement Orientation
* Customer Service Orientation
* Teamwork and Empathy
* Interpersonal Effectiveness
* Adaptability to change
* Innovative
* Managing People and Teams
* Strategic Thinking
* Mentorship Capabilities
* Analytics, Financial Modelling and forecasting
* Strong Presentation skills


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum professional experience of 15 years in a bank or financial institution
* Wealth Management relevant experience of at least 10 years
* Educational qualification in a relevant field (economics, finance, accounting, business management)
* Minimum bachelor’s degree (4 year) or higher. Masters/MBA preferred
* External Wealth Management certification from a recognized institution (CISI level 3 or equivalent)


****Why Commercial Bank****
* Best Performing Bank in Qatar in The Banker’s prestigious Top 1000 World Banks Rankings 2025\.
* Best Digital Bank in the Middle East 2024 by World Finance and Best Mobile Banking App in the Middle East 2024 by Global Finance.
* An Innovation\-Driven, Digital\-First Environment where employees work with the latest tools and technologies to redefine banking
* Opportunities for Global Partnerships \& International Exposure, connecting employees with global networks and perspectives.
* A focus on Employee Well\-being \& Work\-Life Balance, ensuring a healthy and supportive environment for all team members
* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits that ensure our employees are rewarded for their dedication and performance
* A strong Commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion, fostering a culture that values every individual’s unique perspective


 At Commercial Bank, we don’t just offer careers, We shape futures by pioneering

 in Qatar’s banking sector, blending
 **digital\-first** 
 approach to redefine banking through

 solutions.

data.jd_text:
**Your day to day**
* Ensures all food is prepared fresh and is of the highest quality
* Ensure the correct preparation and presentation of dishes in accordance with menu cards and produced on a consistent basis.
* Strictly adheres to all recipes, methods and instructions from supervisor.
* Consistently checks temperatures in foods and follows proper procedures in regards to chilling, re\-heating, and holding food.
* Checks outlet upon arrival to determine status of outstanding safety, or equipment issues
* Checks outlet prior to leaving to ensure cleanliness, proper disposal/removal of food, and proper storing and labeling
* Responsible for accuracy in daily inventories and requisitions.
* Assist the Head Chef in controlling and analyzing on an on\-going basis, the following:
* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.
* Food photo sessions for all new menus – set standard.
* Maintenance of recipe cards for all menu items.
* Staff attendance, rosters
* Assist in production, preparation and presentation of all food items to ensure highest quality at all times.
* Supervise and control the kitchen to meet work requirements.
* Assist Head Chef with inspections of physical of kitchen areas including cold rooms and equipment.
* Assumes responsibilities of Head Chef in his absence.
* Assist in the preparation and testing of outlet and promotional menus following the guidelines: Requirements, competition, trends, recipes, potential cost, availability.
* Maintain and keep up to date training record.
* Ensure team members are informed about new procedures, special events in the hotel, daily functions and food cost and to received feedback.
* Ensure hygiene and sanitation, all precautions on Fire, Health and Safety are taken in the kitchen and that all employees are will trained in this aspect.
* Display good time management techniques with proper planning and control.
* Strives to continuously improve flow of production
* Check regularly perishable food items received for quantity and quality standards.
* Assist Head Chef in the planning \& ordering of food stock in accordance with the volume of business.
* Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.


**FINANCIAL RETURN**
* Assist the Head Chef in supervising the functioning of all Kitchen employees’ facilities and costs to ensure maximum Food \& Beverage departmental profit is achieved.
* Controls and decreases waste by maintaining logs to submit daily/weekly
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system


**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**
* Comply with and ensure adherence to all of the hotel’s policies and procedures
* Comply with all occupational health and safety policies and procedures
* Attend all scheduled meetings
* Inform on a daily basis the Head Chef of all relevant information in operational matters including information, which does not require the Head Chef’s action.
* Liaise with F \& B Controls for food costing, ordering and supply.
* Liaise with departmental heads for co\-ordination of functions and activities.
* Coordinate with kitchen stewarding for proper sanitation, maintenance of equipment, cleaning of cold stores, supply of service dishes, during service hours.
* Maintain a good working relationship with all staff and colleagues throughout the hotel and sister properties.
* Maintain in good working order all hotel property.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times


**PEOPLE**
* Assist scheduling of kitchen staff to ensure proper cover of shift as per business requirements.
* Recommend increments, promotion and transfer of chefs to Head Chef and under his guidance conduct such functions as employee orientation, coaching and supervision, if necessary, to ensure appropriate productivity.
* Assist Head Chef in conducting formal on\-the\-job training session for kitchen employees.
* Utilize coaching skills and demonstrate the development of other team members.


**GENERAL**
* Communicate effectively with all other departments
* Attend meetings, training sessions and any other required meeting or training session.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offering to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Ensure safe work practices are adopted at all time and report any OHS concerns immediately to your direct manager or HR Manager.
* Ensure consistency in quality of appearance and taste, and the best quality menus using the freshest ingredients.
* Effectively participate in the organization of ordering, cost controlling and wastage of food.
* Lead by example and ensure all procedures (HACCP, Health and Safety, and Food Safety Management) are maintained to the required standards to which training has been received, and are being followed by all kitchen members.
* Manage and deliver the production needs of the kitchen to the required standards.
* Manage time through effective planning of work, maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Achieve customer satisfaction rating of above expectations.
* Meet maximum creativity and understanding of food, by creating dishes and assisting with menu development.
* Assigned projects are completed within designated timeframes
* Reports, presentations and other administrative duties are consistently on a high standard; and free of errors and omissions.


**What We Need From You**
**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**
**Education**
* Formal Hospitality Management qualifications in Culinary Institute– desirable
* Completion and awarded Intermediate Food Hygiene Certification
* Completion and awarded HACCP Certification


**Experience**
* At least 5 years previous experience in a hotel or branded units
* Minimum 2 years in similar capacity
* Experience in a high cover International /Mediterranean cuisine
* Knowledge in preparation of all Pastry and bakery products and all culinary operations.
* Knowledge of volume production and ability to maintain the highest quality standards.


**Technical**
* Competent Word, Excel, PowerPoint and software packages
* Competent Oral and Written Communication Skills
* Ability to follow standards recipes and convert quantities mathematically
* Ability to taste all foods to assure correct preparation
* Knowledge of stock control, rotas and budgetary controls


**Personal Attributes**
* ‘Can do’ attitude and a high level of energy
* Professionally groomed
* Able to manage task simultaneously; and priorities
* Flexible and aware of the pressure points within the kitchen environment and adapt to each situation with maturity and calmness.
* Hands\-on attitude, leads by example
* Always goes the extra mile to ensure guests satisfaction.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 31st May 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Please write the Job Description.

data.jd_text:
**Aug 2026 Middle East – Qatar**
**Head of Secondary**
 The first Awfaz Global School was founded in 2009 and offers an outstanding British\-style education to children in the local community. We have 3 campuses across Doha with around 1,500 students. We cater for all nationalities; however, the majority of our students are Qatari Nationals. Our school is continually expanding to meet the needs of our community by providing high\-quality education from Early Years up to IGCSE, with continued expansion into AS and A Level programmes.
   

  

 Awfaz Global School endeavours to provide a holistic education that enables students to grow into confident, caring, and globally minded individuals. We are committed to academic excellence, student wellbeing, and preparing learners for success in higher education and beyond. We are seeking an experienced, dynamic, and forward\-thinking Head of Secondary to join our leadership team for August 2026\.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead the Secondary School with a strong focus on academic achievement, student wellbeing, staff development, and the continued growth of our British curriculum pathway, including IGCSE and A Level provision.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Lead, manage, and develop the Secondary School in alignment with the school’s vision, values, and strategic objectives.
* Oversee the delivery and continuous improvement of the British Curriculum, including Key Stage 3, IGCSE, AS, and A Level programmes.
* Ensure high standards of teaching, learning, assessment, and academic achievement across all secondary phases.
* Support and monitor curriculum planning, data analysis, student progress tracking, and intervention strategies.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and professional growth amongst staff.
* Lead and support Heads of Department to maximise departmental performance and student outcomes.
* Oversee pastoral care, safeguarding, behaviour management, and student wellbeing within the Secondary School.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with students, parents, and the wider school community.
* Contribute to school improvement planning, accreditation processes, inspections, and quality assurance initiatives.
* Support the continued development and expansion of the school’s A Level pathways and university readiness initiatives.


**Skills \& Experience:**
* Proven experience in a senior leadership role within a British Curriculum school.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience with the British Curriculum, including IGCSE and AS/A Level programmes.
* Experience leading academic improvement initiatives and achieving strong examination outcomes.
* Excellent understanding of curriculum development, assessment practices, and secondary school operations.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and people management skills with the ability to inspire and develop teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with students, staff, and parents.
* Experience in school inspections, accreditation processes, and quality assurance frameworks is preferred.
* A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing, and creating a positive learning environment.
* An excellent educator with the ability to model outstanding teaching and learning practices.
