data.jd_text:
**Objective:**
 RCSI Bahrain is seeking to appoint a dynamic and clinically focused Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in Clinical Microbiology to support the delivery of undergraduate and postgraduate medical education within the School of Medicine.
   

  

 Given the clinically integrated nature of the curriculum, the University is specifically seeking a medically qualified clinician with expertise in Infectious Diseases and/or Clinical (Medical) Microbiology. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering clinically relevant microbiology teaching aligned to modern medical practice, patient safety, antimicrobial stewardship, infection prevention, and clinical decision\-making.
   

  

 The appointee will contribute to teaching, assessment, curriculum development, academic advising, and scholarly activity, while supporting the continued integration of microbiology across systems\-based and case\-based learning. The appointee will collaborate closely with the Department of Clinical Microbiology in RCSI Dublin, including participation in teaching and assessment meetings to ensure a coordinated and standardised approach to teaching and assessment across both campuses.
   

  

 Appointment may be made at Lecturer or Senior Lecturer level depending on qualifications, experience, academic profile, and leadership contribution.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Medicine or Nominee
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Teaching:**
 • Deliver high\-quality teaching in microbiology, infectious diseases, infection prevention, and antimicrobial stewardship across undergraduate programmes.
   

 • Contribute to integrated and clinically contextualised teaching within systems\-based and case\-based curricula.
   

 • Facilitate small\-group teaching, tutorials, laboratory interpretation sessions, clinical correlation sessions, and team\-based learning activities.
   

 • Support the development and delivery of clinically relevant microbiology practical and simulation activities.
   

 • Contribute to online and blended learning initiatives using the University’s digital learning platforms.
   

 • Participate in student assessment activities including question writing, OSCEs, practical examinations, standard setting, and moderation processes.
   

 • Participate in teaching and assessment meeting with the Dept of Clinical Microbiology, RCSI, Dublin
   

 • Provide academic mentorship and pastoral support to students.
   

 • Work collaboratively with clinical and basic science colleagues to ensure relevance and consistency of teaching delivery.
   

 • Contribute to curriculum planning, vertical integration, sequencing, and alignment of microbiology and infectious diseases teaching across the undergraduate programme.
   

 • Work collaboratively across disciplines including medicine, pathology, pharmacology, immunology, paediatrics, and public health to support integrated curriculum delivery.
   

 • Support clinically relevant microbiology practical teaching, simulation activities aligned to clinical practice.
   

  

**Research and Scholarship**
 • Contribute to scholarly activity, educational innovation, research, and/or clinical academic initiatives relevant to microbiology or infectious diseases.
   

 • Support student research, audits, quality improvement initiatives, and scholarly dissemination.
   

 • Develop collaborative links with clinical partners and healthcare institutions within Bahrain and wider region.
   

  

**Student Mentoring:**
 • Provide pastoral care, mentorship, and support in developing research projects to students
   

 • Participate in the Personal Tutor Program to support student well\-being and academic development.
   

  

**General:**
 • Participate in School and University committees, working groups, and academic governance activities.
   

 • Support quality assurance, accreditation, and regulatory activities as required.
   

 • Contribute to outreach, student recruitment, and community engagement initiatives.
   

 • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the grade of appointment.
   

 • Attend administrative and academic meetings relevant to clinical teaching.
   

 • Provide regular feedback to the Head of Department on program content and curriculum development and assist in implementing improvements where appropriate
   

 • Ensure that all RCSI Bahrain policies and procedures are adhered to
   

 • Participate in faculty development and medical education training activities as required.
   

 • Familiarises oneself with the RCSI Bahrain Virtual Learning Environment (VLE)
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**Personal Specifications:** 
  

  

 • Medical degree recognised for clinical practice.
   

 • Specialist qualification and/or board certification and/or FRCPath or equivalent in:
   

  

 o Infectious Diseases, and/or
   

 o Medical Microbiology, and/or
   

 o Clinical Microbiology.
   

  

 • Eligibility for professional registration/licensure in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

 • Experience delivering clinical microbiology / infectious diseases teaching.
   

 • Experience in assessment design, moderation, and standard setting.
   

 • Experience with case\-based or blended learning approaches.
   

 • Postgraduate qualification in medical education or ongoing faculty development activity is desirable.
   

 • Ability to deliver high\-quality teaching and educational activities within required timelines.
   

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
   

 • Ability to demonstrate initiative
   

 • Strong organisational and administrative skills

**Streetworks Coordinator**
**South London**
**£30 – £33 per hour (Umbrella)**
 A South London Local Authority is seeking an experienced Streetworks Coordinator to join their Network Management team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Deputy Head of Network Management, you will support the effective delivery of the Council’s statutory duties under the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (NRSWA) and the Traffic Management Act 2004 (TMA), alongside local permit schemes across the borough.
   

  

 You will be responsible for assessing and inspecting streetworks, coordinating utility activities, and ensuring works across the borough’s road network—particularly on SRN and TLRN routes—are carried out efficiently and compliantly.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Assessing and inspecting streetworks to ensure compliance with legislation and permit conditions
* Coordinating planned works across multiple stakeholders, including utility companies
* Monitoring the impact of works on the highway network and minimising disruption
* Ensuring compliance with the Council’s Network Management Duty
* Supporting the development and improvement of processes and systems for coordinating streetworks
* Undertaking site inspections in line with the Red Book and reinstatement inspections under the Specification for the Reinstatement of Openings in Highways (SROH)


 About You You will bring strong technical knowledge and practical experience within streetworks and network management, alongside excellent communication and coordination skills.
   

  

**Essential Knowledge \& Skills**
* In\-depth knowledge of NRSWA 1991, TMA 2004, and the Highways Act 1980
* Strong understanding of compliance inspections, including the Red Book and SROH
* Knowledge of Health \& Safety legislation relating to highway works
* Understanding of local government and contract management processes


**Experience Required**
* Proven experience coordinating and managing streetworks or roadworks
* Experience conducting site inspections and ensuring legislative compliance
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions
* Experience working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines
* Experience dealing effectively with conflict


 Qualifications
   

  

* NRSWA Accreditation (essential)
* Full UK Driving Licence (essential)

Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game
 



  





 At Al\-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
 



  





 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model
* Support the planning and delivery of monthly training programmes across age groups with clear development objectives
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of individual development practices within the Academy



  





**Individual Development and Coaching** 




  




* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model
* Support players across all Academy age groups (U13–U21\) in their individual development journeys
* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression



  





**Analysis and Performance Support** 




  




* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)
* Collaborate with the Performance Analysis department to enhance player development resources



  





**Collaboration and Player Development** 




  




* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews
* Work closely with multidisciplinary staff across the Academy to support holistic player development
* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




  




* AFC Pro License or UEFA equivalent
* FIFA Guardian safeguarding qualification
* Skills, Knowledge and Experience:



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



  




* AFC A License or UEFA equivalent
* Proven experience coaching elite academy players
* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East
* Strong leadership and teamwork experience



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.
 



  





 The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment. All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.
 



  





**If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.**

data.jd_text:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a role that will help you stand out at HSBC, take a look at how you can fulfil your potential.
   

  

 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

 Credit \& Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit \& Lending (C\&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as a Country Head of CCM Services \& Lead BCO.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Be Responsilbe For**
* Ensuring CCM OKRs are achieved for their respective market
* Leading the execution and implementation of the BCO function, to efficiently manage the underwriting process across country CIB. The BCO function to be globally leading across the bank, leveraging organizational design capabilities to optimize processes and structures.
* Taking a lead in managing the portfolio and risk exposure partnering with banking teams and WCRM to determine and monitor risk appetite
* Driving policy and procedure simplification / optimization to make the underwriting process more effective with a focus on value\-add activities and creating risk differentiated processes
* Continuously focus on improving the productivity of the function whilst enhancing client experience
* Providing oversight to outsourced credit \& capital management services
* Landing an ambitious multi\-year transformation journey within their market
* Implementing the Target CCM Services Operating Model and delivering financial targets associated with its’ implementation in the market
* Leading risk and control management across the end\-to\-end process
* Manage CCM COO FRP, budgeting and planning processes for the market
* Land locally the transformation and digitisation of the CCM COO journey and lead local initiatives to improve and re\-engineer processes for the market
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback, identifying key areas of focus to significantly improve customer outcomes for the market
* Represent CCM Services in front of market stakeholders and at market forum
* Unify and provide direction to a dislocated set of smaller teams, fostering a sense of unity and purpose and embed the Target CCM services operating model
* Develop and maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.
* Oversee and execute the delivery of CCM services in\-country (where required), ensuring alignment with regional processes and a seamless and efficient process for customers
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback within the market, identifying local areas of focus to improve customer outcomes while ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders, including technology, CCM, WCRM, Legal, the global business Coverage teams, digital channels and products to implement the overall strategy for the wholesale credit and lending journey.
* Implement governance frameworks to ensure risks and issues related to the Credit \& Lending journey are escalated to regional, and global stakeholders and resolved in a satisfactory manner. Monitor the management of financial and non\-financial risks pertaining to the CCM production in partnership with local NFR/Business Risk.

Manage and execute local end\-to\-end processes for Credit \& Lending on behalf of the CIB Business. Monitor and manage local risk and controls across the end\-to\-end controls, meeting all SOX obligations.

* Collaborate with the CCMS Product, Design and Innovation Pillar, technology and transformation teams to execute the technology strategy for CCM, reduce legacy technologies, and drive a culture of innovation by developing cutting\-edge automation, capability, and business solutions leveraging next\-gen technologies, AI, and analytics.
* Manage multiple senior stakeholders with varied and sometimes conflicting agendas, effectively navigating complex situations and driving alignment.
* Maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.


**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**
* Extensive years of experience in wholesale credit and lending, with a strong background in coverage, credit management or operations
* Proven track record of leading and managing teams, with experience in organizational design and strategic planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.
* Expertise in credit risk management, control assessment, and SOX compliance.
* Experience in driving digitisation and customer experience improvement initiatives.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to consume large volumes of customer feedback and distil key areas of focus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

* Promote a collective culture to spread experience and best practice and live the Group Values.

* Promotes innovative and lateral thinking approach for devising solutions.
* Bring thought leadership and governance around the internal and external lending ecosystem.

* Self\-motivation, and a proven rapid learning capability in a changing environment are essential

The role focuses on ensuring that the group’s portfolio strikes the right balance between risk and reward while aligning with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 The incumbent is responsible for the preparation and maintenance of portfolio models, integrating key metrics, and providing alternative scenario plans to aid investment decisions and resource allocation.

* Assist in the development of dynamic portfolio models, incorporating discretionary and non\-discretionary investments to evaluate various scenarios for the annual work program, budget, and investment projection.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to collect \& structure relevant data for use in modelling \& scenario planning, including financial data, project status, and market trends.
* Ensure all submissions are collected \& comply with frameworks and adherence to modeling requirements.
* Perform sensitivity analyses to evaluate the impact of potential market fluctuations on the group’s portfolio.
* Support the preparation of investment endorsement documentation for the Group Management Committee (GMC), ensuring alignment with group strategy and capital allocation priorities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field. master’s degree is desired.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate portfolio management, strategic planning, or investment analysis role.
* Advanced knowledge of portfolio management theory, financial modelling, risk management frameworks, and performance measurement tools.
* Proficiency in portfolio management software, financial modelling tools (Excel, SAP, Oracle), and data visualization platforms.
* Strong analytical abilities to evaluate and integrate complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively cooperate with all stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment is of utmost importance and is a team player at heart.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work under tight deadlines in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

 The integrated Company leading the energy transition in the Kingdom of Bahrain, powering the next generation.

 CFA, CAIA, or equivalent professional certifications. Additional programming skills (R, SQL, etc.). Experience with emerging markets. Proven portfolio management track record.

 Zaleej Real Estate Company (KSCC)

 Project Management
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO
   

  

**About Us**
 Zaleej Real Estate Company (KSCC) is the Kuwait real estate company that manages a diversified portfolio of commercial and residential properties across Kuwait, combining institutional\-grade asset management with hands\-on operational excellence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Project Manager leads Zaleej's real estate development and construction projects from concept through to handover, covering mid\- to large\-scale residential, commercial, and mixed\-use developments across Kuwait. The role takes full ownership of project lifecycle delivery — design coordination, permitting, tendering, construction supervision, commercial administration, and closeout — while managing multidisciplinary teams, external consultants, and contractors. Success in this role is measured by on\-time, on\-budget delivery, quality of finished assets, and the strength of relationships built with consultants, authorities, and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead the full project lifecycle from initiation and feasibility through permitting, tendering, construction, and closeout
* Develop and manage detailed project execution plans (PEPs), budgets, schedules, and resource allocations
* Forecast project cash flow requirements and coordinate timely contractor and consultant payments to maintain project momentum
* Select and onboard suitable consultants, contractors, and vendors, ensuring competitive pricing and proven capability for the scope at hand
* Coordinate closely with architects, engineers, quantity surveyors, legal consultants, and government authorities for permits and regulatory compliance


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead internal project teams and supervise external consultants and contractors, providing clear direction and accountability for performance
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all project stakeholders, including senior leadership, regulatory bodies, and utility providers
* Develop and mentor junior team members through structured on\-the\-job training and clearly defined performance objectives


**Construction Oversight**
* Monitor site activities to ensure adherence to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety standards
* Conduct regular site visits, chair weekly progress meetings, and issue concise project status reports to senior management
* Identify and proactively mitigate risks, change orders, and project delays


**Commercial \& Contractual Administration**
* Negotiate cost, scope, quality, and schedule terms with consultants, contractors, and suppliers to protect commercial and delivery outcomes
* Review, negotiate, and manage construction contracts, procurement schedules, and tender documents
* Approve invoices, monitor financial performance against budget, and enforce cost controls


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Maintain accurate project documentation including progress reports, meeting minutes, variation logs, and regulatory submissions
* Provide regular project status updates to senior leadership, including risk assessments, mitigation strategies, and forward\-looking recommendations


**Requirements**
**Essential (Must\-Have)**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline from an accredited university
* Active membership of the Kuwait Society of Engineers (KSE), or eligibility to register within a defined timeframe
* Minimum 8 years' experience in real estate development and construction project management, with at least 3 years in a project leadership role
* Proven track record of successfully delivering mid\- to large\-scale residential, commercial, or mixed\-use projects in Kuwait or the GCC
* Strong working knowledge of Kuwait's building regulations, permitting processes, municipal approvals, and construction safety standards
* Proficiency in project management and design software, including Primavera P6, MS Project, and AutoCAD
* Bilingual fluency in English and Arabic (written and spoken) — essential for liaising with authorities, consultants, and contractors
* Valid Kuwait driving licence and transferable Article 18 residency visa


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**
* Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or RICS
* Working knowledge of Civil 3D, GIS, and Building Information Modelling (BIM) software
* Experience with sustainable construction practices and green building certifications (e.g. LEED, ESTIDAMA)
* Established network of contacts within Kuwait's consultant, contractor, and government ecosystem


**Benefits**
**WHAT WE OFFER**
* Opportunity to lead a meaningful pipeline of development projects within a principal\-led, long\-term investment group
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and real influence over project strategy, design quality, and delivery standards
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment that values initiative, integrity, and continuous improvement


**How To Apply**
 Apply via the online application form: https://airtable.com/appwm2VUujXVQ2mIB/shrBmmYJs7pftZ2kJ
   

  

 Select "Project Manager \- KWT (Bilingual)" as the job position and reference code when completing the form.
   

  

 Alternatively, email your CV directly to hr@zaleej.com with the subject line "Project Manager".
   

  

*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We appreciate all applications.*

 Job Summary
 
 The Business Partner is the key and strategic interface between IT and the Business.  •Research and share new technology and bring industry best practices 
   

 •Prepare business IT budget in view of IT plans
   

 •Project Management to ensure desired objectives are achieved within defined timelines, cost and quality
   

 •Manage external vendors in terms of contracts, SLA, process alignment and payments
   

 •Work with IT to ensure that all incidents, service requests and change requests are managed within agreed service level agreements as per agreed quality standards.
   

 •Be a custodian of business processes with an objective to digitize the processes and eliminate manual work and inefficiencies
   

 •Work with the business and IT to improve Master Data Management (MDM). While primary ownership for MDM is with the business, IT must assist in the process by improving system configurations and controls, and providing timely and regular reports.

 •Maximize the use of system controls to reduce reliance on costly and inefficient manual controls.
   

 •Translate business unit plans into specific IT requirements and programs/projects.

 •Implement IT policies and guidelines in the business and work with audit to ensure proper implementation of IT policies and guidelines.

* Enforcing procurement policies, standards, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and methodologies across the organization to ensure compliance.

data.jd_text:
**Objective** 




 The Head of Operational Excellence is responsible for establishing and embedding a sustainable culture of continuous improvement across the Group’s diverse business verticals including trading \& manufacturing, engineering, automotive, power solutions, financial services, office automation, car rental, and leasing etc. The role carries a Group\-wide mandate and is positioned to deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, quality, customer experience, financial performance, and overall Group competitiveness. The Head of Operational Excellence will collaborate closely with respective MDs and Divisional Heads to assess existing operational processes and implement best\-in\-class strategies and frameworks tailored to each division’s operational requirements and challenges.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the Group’s Operational Excellence strategy, roadmap, and governance framework.
* Lead the deployment of Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies across business units to drive efficiency, quality, sustainable cost optimization, and cross\-functional operational synergies.
* Partner with executive leadership and business heads to identify transformation priorities and translate them into measurable business outcomes.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high\-performing Operational Excellence team, supported by a network of internal change agents and certified practitioners.
* Define and monitor performance indicators, benchmark against industry best practice, and report progress, risks, and transformation outcomes to senior management through effective governance and performance reporting mechanisms.
* Lead change management, capability development, and the institutionalisation of best practices Group\-wide.



  





**Expected Outcomes** 



* Achieve measurable improvements in operational efficiency, process effectiveness and service quality across all Group’s business divisions.
* Implement sustainable cost optimization strategies through process improvement, resource optimization, and operational standardization.
* Increase customer satisfaction across service\-oriented divisions by improving response times, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure the successful execution of key strategic operational projects within approved scope, timelines, and budget, with no major delays or cost overruns.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, innovation, and operational excellence across all levels of the organization.



  





**Educational Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field is required, a Master’s degree or MBA is highly preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification (or Black Belt supported by a demonstrable leadership track record)



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum of 12–15 years of progressive experience in Operational Excellence, Business Transformation, or Continuous Improvement, with a substantial portion in senior leadership roles.
* Proven track record of implementing large\-scale operational excellence programs within a multi\-industry environment (e.g., manufacturing, financial services, automotive, etc.)
* Prior experience in the GCC region will be considered a distinct advantage.



  





**Skills and Competencies** 



* Demonstrated success leading enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives, operational improvement programs, and cross\-functional strategic projects, ideally within a multi\-sector group or large conglomerate environment.
* Strong commercial acumen, executive presence, and proven ability to influence at Board and C\-suite level.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership capabilities.
* Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable.



  





**Benefits** 



* Attractive fixed and variable compensation
* Staff car
* Paid annual leave



  





**Job Remarks** 



* Preferred Language: English, Arabic
* Job Country: Kuwait
* Duty Shift / Timings: One Shift / 07:00 AM to 03:00 PM

Responsibilities
   

 \- Perform annual Risk Assessment of the entire Audit Universe for Mashreq Kuwait
   

  

 \- Preparing the Annual Audit Plan for the Branch and obtain Group Chief of Internal Audit approval for the plan.
   

  

 \- Ensuring that the Bank is in Compliance with the various requirements of the relevant Regulator and their guidelines on various types of audits required to be done in the Country and keep the Country Management Committee (MANCO) updated of the status of the same.
   

  

 \- Providing complete and timely information to the Country Head/Branch Management to ensure proper oversight of the audit processes e.g. audit planning/audit plan progress update/status of open\-overdue issues
   

  

 \- Managing (where applicable) a team of specialist Resident Internal auditor(s) in delivering fulfillment of 100% of the Annual Audit Plan for Mashreq Kuwait, ensuring adherence with all applicable IIA professional standards and Divisional Quality standards.
   

  

 \- Interfacing with the Regulators to represent the Internal Audit function. Ensure that regulatory requirements pertaining to Internal Audit are met in effective and timely manner.
   

  

 \- Planning and carrying out audits, reviews, analyzing and risk ranking gaps according to various risk and value implications. Discussing and helping to develop action plans as a remedial measure to mitigate composite risks.
   

  

 \- Determining areas of risk and appraising their significance in relation to operational factor of cost and quality.
   

  

 \- Accurately dimensioning and assigning ratings and communicating the impact of recommended actions.
   

  

 \- Providing consultative support and guidance to Country Management, where requested, by providing expert professional opinion in product development, process improvement in a seamless manner as processes run through various areas.
   

  

  

 Experience
   

  

 \- Degree Educated with further education to include an ACCA/ACA/CPA/MBA/CIA
   

 \- 15\+ years of experience (mainly in audit) and demonstrated abilities in a banking environment in areas of increasing responsibility; with a minimum of 5 years spent at supervisory/managerial level.
   

 \- Specialized knowledge, comprehension and understanding of products and composite risks within Wholesale (IBG/TGM) Business Segments as well as Operations, Technology \& Risk Management (preferably), ability to project and assess risk end to end, and those not seen by specialists in each business areas is a must.
   

 \- Thorough understanding of various Regulatory guidelines,
   

 \- Proven track record of managing and interacting with regulators
   

 \- High caliber person with proven track record.
   

 \- Team leadership qualities (confident, clarity of thoughts, etc.) and excellent oral and written communication skills.
   

 \- Result and business oriented disciplined thinker, a self\-starter with strong analytical organization
   

 \- Ability to command respect by demonstration of skills and presenting and offering practical and effective solutions is a key success factor.

data.jd_text:
**Citi Country Officer \& Banking Head (CCO) Kuwait\- Director
   

  

 (Kuwaiti nationals encouraged to apply)**
 Citi was amongst the first foreign banks to establish presence on the ground in Kuwait in 2006, with deep routed relationships with the state dating back to the 1950s. The business in Kuwait is an Institutional Clients Group (ICG) franchise supported by circa 35 employees in country. The business activity covers the Public Sector, Private Sector, and Financial institutions with well\-developed client relationships.
   

  

 The Citi franchise in Kuwait will be part of the newly formed Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster. This new Sub\-Cluster is positioned to cover a geography with significant wealth and appetite for investments locally and globally. The Kuwait CCO \& BH, along with the rest of the Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster CCOs, will report directly to Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster Head.
   

  

 The Citi Country Officer \& Banking Head is the face of Citi in the country, playing the crucial role of leading and protecting the Citi franchise. In both leading the business and protecting the franchise, the CCO \& BH must achieve collaboration and alignment across all stakeholders – effectively managing a large matrix team.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Franchise Management in terms of developing and executing Citi’s overall client’s and business strategy to achieve both short and long\- term goals in compliance with corporate standards and local regulations.
* Ensuring compliance with all corporate policies, including ethical standards, corporate governance standards and business practice requirements.
* Applying judgment in understanding issues and making sound decisions that support, confirm, and enhance Citi's mission and vision.
* Identifying, assessing, mitigating, communicating, and anticipating all types of risks through the development and sustainability of appropriate control mechanisms.
* Overseeing, and escalating as necessary, the resourcing requirements of the legal entity to perform its governance, risk management and compliance obligations and reporting material risks / issues affecting the legal entity to the appropriate governance committees.
* Exhibit efficient and effective leadership that touches all parts of the franchise and provides a strong role model.
* Ability to attain and maintain strong relationship management with clients, government officials, regulators, employees, and media that engender a high level of trust and transparency to support the development of Citi’s market position and growth.
* In partnership with HR, executing Citi’s Talent agenda and overseeing franchise\-wide Talent review and development activities.
* Sponsor employee engagement across the franchise ensuring employees at all levels are engaged, productive and effective.
* Leading Citi’s response to a franchise\-wide event, e.g. crisis or disaster.
* Protecting Citi’s reputation in the country.
* Managing (directly or through matrix reporting, as appropriate) all businesses, product lines and functions based in country.
* Managing the organization and corporate governance of country\-based legal entities and their regulatory reporting.
* Leading management and coordination of governmental and regulatory relationships.
* Providing oversight for all critical country and other risk limits and for country scenario planning.
* Ensuring compliance with all applicable requirements regarding financial inclusion.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
* Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.
* Develop and monitor a client\-driven franchise growth strategy which is delivered through people and franchise management.
* Oversight of Citi’s Banking organization. The unified Banking \& International organization oversees the local delivery of the full firm to clients in each of the markets where Citi has onshore presence.
* Responsible for the Kuwait Banking P\&L. The role will have responsibility for both flow and episodic revenue which requires strong leadership, risk skills, corporate finance mindset and partnerships to deliver best in class solutions.
* Drive innovation and speed to market and promote cross\-selling of products across the full platform.
* Responsible for overall parent relationship management of clients and providing a wide range of treasury and corporate finance solutions, including cash management, trade, vendor finance, FX, general credit, loans, debt capital markets, share repurchase, and interest rate and equity derivatives.
* Ensuring efficient use of Capital and that Capital returns (RORC and RoTCE) are delivered across the franchise.
* Responsible for meeting revenue goals and other goals related to budget, risk management, and credit allocation in partnership with GCM and Risk.
* Lead the Sustainability agenda and the digital transformation for clients with particular emphasis on digital natives and digital tools.


**Qualifications** 
**:**
* Have at least 15 years of experience, of which at least 12 years in banking, finance or economic affairs related to their competence in banking activities, with at least 7 years in key executive positions in those areas.
* Strong Corporate Finance and Credit skills. Senior Credit Officer (SCO) certification.
* Business Management and running a P\&L.
* In\-depth experience and understanding of banking products – loans / debts (short and long\-term), capital management, cash management, trade products, corporate and structured finance, DCM, and derivatives products.
* Relationship/stakeholder management with both internal and external stakeholders
* Proven leadership skills and strategic thinking to create momentum and a collective agenda across multiple products with a diverse population and competing priorities.
* Ability to anticipate and lead the organizational response to future changes and translate vision into executable plans.
* Ability to drive and foster simplification to achieve efficiency.
* Navigating corporate governance frameworks.
* Understanding and translating global/regional strategy.
* Previous experience of managing Risk, Finance and Controls.


**Education:**
* A minimum of first degree or its equivalent in any discipline plus a higher degree or professional qualification in any business\-related discipline.

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to join our team in Ahmadi, Kuwait, supporting the Kuwait Environmental Remediation Program (KERP).
   

  

 You will play a pivotal role in delivering large\-scale environmental restoration initiatives. With millions of square meters of contaminated land successfully remediated, this project represents a globally significant effort in sustainable environmental recovery.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to contribute to transforming impacted land into safe, productive ecosystems while leading complex engineering and construction operations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead the overall management, coordination, and supervision of assigned remediation projects.
* Oversee budget development, cost control, and quality assurance to ensure successful project delivery.
* Manage engineering, procurement, and construction contractors on behalf of the Client.
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual obligations.
* Develop and implement the soil remediation strategy for assigned areas, including contracting and execution approaches.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary technical interface with the Client.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring expectations are consistently met.
* Proactively resolve scope, schedule, and performance issues.

data.jd_text:
Georgetown University in Qatar (GU\-Q) is dedicated to fulfilling Georgetown University's mission of promoting intellectual, ethical and spiritual understanding through serious and sustained discourse among people of different faiths, cultures, and beliefs. Embodying this spirit of the University, Georgetown's Qatar campus undertakes education, research, and service in order to advance knowledge and provide students and the community with a holistic educational experience that produces global citizens committed to the service of humankind. We demonstrate the values of Georgetown University; seek to build upon the world\-class reputation of the Edmund A. Walsh School of Foreign Service; and work with our partner, Qatar Foundation, in its endeavors to achieve the Qatar National Vision 2030\.
   

  

**Requirements**
 The Writing Center Manager,
 **located in Doha, Qatar** 
 , leads the strategic and day\-to\-day operations of the Writing Center, advancing Writing Across the Curriculum (WAC) initiatives and promoting excellence in academic writing across disciplines. The role combines teaching, faculty development, research, and program innovation, while supervising professional staff and peer tutors. Working closely with the Director for Student Academic Success, the role contributes to institutional teaching and learning priorities.
   

  

**This position is full\-time, for a one\-year term, with the possibility of renewal. The position is eligible for sponsorship and benefits, including medical insurance, housing allowance, home leave travel, and dependent education support. As it is based in Doha, Qatar and offers no relocation assistance, GU\-Q invites only locally based candidates who already hold a valid Qatar residence permit to apply.**
**Key Accountabilities**
* Coordinate the operations and activities of a dynamic writing center. Provide expert tutoring for students' needs in academic writing across the disciplines.
* Lead Writing Across the Curriculum (WAC) initiatives, collaborating with faculty across disciplines and in key first year courses, to strengthen the development of student writing.
* Design and implement innovative programs that promote reading, critical thinking, and information literacy across the curriculum.
* Contribute to the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SOTL) through research, assessment and publication of writing center practices and outcomes.
* Teach, subject to curricular need, first\-year writing courses, summer writing workshops, and other special writing programs/courses (cross\-registration, ABP program, etc.).


**Key Activities**
* Provide expert tutoring for the various academic needs of GU\-Q students.
* Meet with faculty to discuss the needs of students in academic writing across the disciplines.
* Partner with faculty to design discipline\-specific writing assignments and integrate writing\-to\-learn pedagogies into their courses.
* Facilitate faculty development workshops on writing pedagogy, assignment design, and responding to student writing.
* Identify and disseminate resources for academic writing and academic achievement.
* Develop and lead innovative programs that integrate reading, writing, and critical thinking skills, including digital literacy initiatives.
* Conduct research and assessment on writing center effectiveness and student learning outcomes. Share findings through presentations and publications.
* Assist the Director for Student Academic Success in the delivery of teaching, learning and assessment initiatives, based on current trends in writing center scholarship and evidence\-based literacy practices.
* Manage project development.
* Lead writing workshops and other writing\-related seminars and labs.
* Teach at least one first year writing course per semester.
* Administer and assist with the English writing assessment at New Student Orientation/Hoya Welcome Week.
* Manage and oversee the work of direct reports, including scheduling, setting and reviewing performance objectives, and identifying and scheduling training and development needs.
* Liaise with Human Resources to manage recruitment, hiring, onboarding and offboarding of direct reports, as required.
* Recruit, hire, train, supervise and mentor student peer tutors and fellows in supporting critical reading and multimodal composition.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Knowledge of writing center dynamics and current best practices in writing center administration.
* Knowledge of Writing Across the Curriculum/Writing in the Disciplines theories and pedagogies.
* Understanding evidence\-based approaches to teaching reading comprehension and critical thinking.
* Familiarity with SOTL methodologies, including assessment design and educational research.
* Ability to work well with various forms of technology to support program operations and writing development including AI tools, Google Suite, Microsoft Office Suite, online data management software, social media tools, collaborative writing spaces, etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work well in a collaborative, learning\-focused, team environment.
* Strong facilitation and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated commitment to assessment and evidence\-based practice preferred.


**Qualifications**
* Master degree in Rhetoric and Composition, Applied Linguistics, TESOL, Education or a related writing\-intensive field. Doctoral degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of relevant work experience in higher education in the MENA/SWANA region.
* 5\+ years of experience teaching or tutoring academic writing at the college level.
* Experience working with diverse learners.
* 2\+ years' experience with supervising/coordinating/managing staff and project development.
* Previous administrative experience.
* Experience with Writing Across the Curriculum programs or faculty development preferred.


**Current Georgetown Employees**
 If you currently work at Georgetown University, please exit this website and login to GMS (gms.georgetown.edu) using your Net ID and password. Then select the Career worklet on your GMS Home dashboard to view Jobs at Georgetown.
   

  

**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at Georgetown University in Qatar, you must submit a resume/CV for each position of interest. Documents are not kept on file for future positions.
   

  

**Need Assistance**
 Need some assistance with the application process? Contact us at guqhr@georgetown.edu.
   

  

**EEO Statement**
 GU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship, color, disability, family responsibilities, gender identity and expression, genetic information, marital status, matriculation, national origin, race, religion, personal appearance, political affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Georgetown University offers a wide variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits. Benefits packages include comprehensive health, dental and vision plans, disability and life insurance coverage, retirement savings programs, tuition assistance, voluntary insurance options (including group legal, accident, and critical illness), and much more. Whatever your need, the Office of Faculty and Staff Benefits will be standing by to support you. You can learn more about the benefits offered to eligible faculty and staff at https://benefits.georgetown.edu or view the online interactive benefits guide for more information.
   

  

 Georgetown University in Qatar (GU\-Q) is located on the Education City campus in Doha, Qatar and offers a variety of lifelong learning opportunities for the community. The four\-year Bachelor of Science in Foreign Service (BSFS) degree program is delivered by the world renowned Edmund A. Walsh School of Foreign Service with a curriculum that is identical to that offered to students in Washington, D. C. Each year, GU\-Q admits a class of approximately 100 students, primarily from the Middle East, South Asia and Southeast Asia. GU\-Q is sponsored by Qatar Foundation and is one of six American universities located within Education City. All students have access to a superb range of recreational and housing facilities offered by Qatar Foundation and they take classes in classrooms equipped with state of the art technology. The campus currently boasts the presence of one of the largest public access libraries in Qatar. The compensation, benefits, terms of employment and professional development opportunities for GU\-Q faculty and staff are highly competitive.

data.jd_text:
**Director of Project Management** 




  





 Majid Al Futtaim is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Project Management to lead the delivery of large\-scale residential, non\-residential, infrastructure, and landscape development projects.
 



 This leadership role will oversee the full project lifecycle — from planning and procurement through execution, handover, and post\-delivery customer experience. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability.
 



  





**PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 • The Director of Project Management reports to the Chief Development Officer and works in close partnership with the Director of Development. The Director of Project Management is responsible for the delivery of all residential, non\-residential buildings and infrastructure (civil and landscape) works for the development.
 



 • The role requires development of short and long term planning for delivery of the project business plan. Monthly forecasting and monitoring of progress of works (cost time and quality) to handover is required to ensure cash and revenue projections are achieved.
 



 • Bring together, direct and manage all PM staff, contractors and consultants with clear briefing and management for all works, demonstrating a strong presence on site as a “hands on” leader.
 



 • Control time, cost, quality and health and safety via clear direction and management tools (dashboards, programs, budgets, meetings) to ensure design intent is delivered, resulting in a positive customer experience combined with efficiency of operations.
 



 • Prioritise response to any direct requests or instructions given by Senior Shareholder representatives and ensure full resolution agreed with the Shareholder expeditiously, at all times in liaison with and sign off by the DM team of such process.
 



 • Develop Best Practice methodology in benchmarking and value engineering to ensure cost efficiency without jeopardizing initial development concepts/customer expectations at time of pre\-sales.
 



 • Review existing operations \& administrative systems \& streamline as required to optimize resource efficiency.
 



 • Prepare clear \& concise RFP’s consistent with budgets for consultant \& contractor selection process as necessary \& in liaison with DM team.
 



 • Lead \& report on WOW initiatives as relate to PM operations and Capex across development projects.
 



 • Working closely with the customer experience/FM teams and managing the aftercare team is essential to ensure a positive customer experience continues post\-handover.
 



 • Develop safety, sustainability \& innovation strategies and targets for each business plan year.
 



 • Report regularly, and with clarity and transparently at all times.
 



 • Manage internal audits to ensure that company procedures and policies are being followed and adhered to.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Key Tasks** 




 • Manage delivery of all residential, non\-residential built form and infrastructure works.
 



 • Use, and develop where necessary, key processes and procedures to ensure monitoring and management of time, cost and quality for all projects.
 



 • Work in close cooperation with the Director of Development on design of all works and ensure the delivery of design intent is achieved.
 



 • Develop and manage budget for all costs to ensure KPI’s are achieved.
 



 • Work with CDO, development and finance teams to develop business plan strategy.
 



 • Forecast and manage handover of all works to ensure Business Plan cash flow and revenue projections are achieved on, or ahead of target.
 



 • Procure all services with clear and concise briefing, pre\-qualification, negotiation and appointment in line with company policies and procedures.
 



 • Focus on cash management of works to ensure the most efficient use of company\-wide CAPEX.
 



 • Ensure strategy of handover of works to FM is comprehensive and well planned starting at the concept design stage, to ensure seamless handover resulting in a positive customer experience.
 



 • Ensure supportive relationship with Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer experience at all touch points relative to the PM function.
 



 • HSE compliance to be in line with best practice to maintain/improve track record.
 



 • Risk management framework regularly updated and managed to avoid negative impacts and ensure efficient, financially and corporate compliance via transparent, sustainable and safe operations at all time.
 



 • Ensure approvals/licenses and other obligations are procured and adhered to for all works.
 



 • Develop a meeting framework to ensure clear briefing, direction and follow up of the PM team, contractors, consultants and liaison with other in house staff to meet agreed KPIs.
 



 • Provide clear, concise and transparent reporting and communication to senior management on a monthly basis, including weekly meeting and updates to CDO.
 



 • Ensure sustainability initiatives are developed and targets adhered to for the project.
 



 • Foster innovation within the team to achieve companywide innovation targets.
 



 • Develop and foster strong relationships with key government authorities, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth management and delivery of projects.
 



 • Foster motivation and develop a collaborative team environment where the Development Management \& Project Management teams work seamlessly.
 



  





**PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 • BSc in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
 



 • 15\+ years of Middle East work experience in the development field, with the majority of experience being client\-side.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





**Functional Knowledge** 




 • Deep knowledge of built form and infrastructure within large scale/multiple project environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of development processes and procedures.
 



 • Strong understanding of customer needs and business value drivers.
 



 • Proficient in software applications such as AutoCAD, MS Project, MS Office, BIM, and related systems.
 



  





**Technical Competencies** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills.
 



 • Strong budgeting and future planning skills.
 



  





**Management Competencies** 




 • Leads by example.
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Strong interpersonal relationship skills.
 



 • Initiative and proactive mindset.
 



 • Diplomacy and stakeholder management.
 



  





**Communication** 




 • Effective writing and reporting skills.
 



 • Ability to deliver presentations across a variety of situations and topics.
 



 • Strong relationship development and maintenance skills.
 



 • Strong internal communication capabilities.
 



 • Fluency in English, both verbal and written, is preferred. Fluency in Arabic would be advantageous but not essential.
 



  





**Core Values** 




 • Bold
 



 • Passionate
 



 • Togetherness

**Join our Team**

 Ericsson connects people, businesses, and societies through mobile networks. We are looking for a
 **Customer Project Manager**

 The role reports to the Head of PMO in CU GULF.

* Lead planning, execution, and deployment of mobile radio network projects (RAN, 5G)

* Continuously improve project methods, tools, and ways of working


**You Will Bring**
**Required:**

* Degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, IT, or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience delivering mobile network / RAN rollout projects, including 5G
* Strong track record in customer\-facing project leadership within complex environments
* Ability to manage multi\-stakeholder ecosystems across customers, teams, and suppliers
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting
* Clear communication, leadership, and influencing skills
* Structured, proactive, and solution\-focused approach
* Fluency in English and Arabic


**Advantageous:**
* Experience with operators in the Middle East
* Background in network modernization, swap, or large\-scale rollout programs
* PMP, Prince2, or equivalent project management certification
* Experience managing subcontractors and third\-party suppliers

**Based in Oman**
**About Astrazeneca**
 AstraZeneca is a global, science\-led, patient\-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* The Oncology Project Manager is responsible for the development and execution of oncology franchise Access strategies across the full product lifecycle in Oman, including pre\-registration, pre\-launch, launch, and post\-launch phases.
* The role drives cross\-functional coordination to enable optimal patient access, supports key account engagement, and contributes to the development of sustainable oncology ecosystems across the country, including expansion beyond Muscat into high\-potential regions and strengthening diagnostic infrastructure.
* Lead the engagements with payers and key stakeholders with the purpose of achieving and maintaining reimbursement \& patient access of AZ OBU Portfolio in Oman Key accounts
* Based in Oman.
* Reports directly to OBU Market Access Head, Gulf.


**What You’ll Do**
**Develop and Execute Oncology Access strategy to ensure achieving early access goals for existing and new launches, supporting overall Oman ambition** 
 :
   

  

* Establish Market Access strategies, objectives, and tactical plans in alignment with the brand strategies.
* Lead with the cross\-functional team to develop and execute Pre\-launch Market Access Strategies and plans driving accelerated access to key accounts.
* Work with cross functional teams to Implement market access short term tactics \& long\-term strategies, implement brand expansion accessibility plans supporting the life cycle management of OBU AZ portfolio.
* Identify, build, map enlisting processes and stakeholders involved. Maintain strong business relationships with key decision makers, relevant stakeholders and influencers.
* Contribute in developing relevant evidence supporting the access, generated through clinical trials, Health Economics models, RWE (Real World Evidence) studies, systematic literature research and meta\-analysis effectively substantiating the full value potential of OBU AZ brands.
* Build relevant, solid, and localized value propositions, arguments with supporting evidence for accelerated and sustainable access.
* Collaborate with the Cross\-functional team to develop pricing and contracting strategies to support AstraZeneca’s product positioning and penetration. Develop relevant pricing, outcomes\-based agreements and contracting activities.
* Generate insights of market \& stakeholders, identify areas of partnership/ market opportunities and threats to AZ business and provide deliverable solutions \& recommendations.
* Monitor environment and practices for shifts, trends or behaviors, interprets likely impact. Set up innovative and impactful projects, recommend actions that support the needs of the customers and create win\-win partnerships.
* Liaise and communicate with Oman government and private organisations to ensure relevant parties understand the positioning of AstraZeneca’s products, remove access barrier and deliver value\-based discussions for OBU AZ products.
* Drive geographic Access expansion beyond Muscat, including engagement in: Sohar, Sur, Salalah as potential examples.
* Map and optimize patient referral pathways to key centers.
* Support the development of sustainable oncology diagnostic capabilities and biomarker testing access
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, and Supply teams.
* Map diagnostic pathways and support initiatives to enhance biomarker testing capabilities.
* Contribute to building sustainable in\-country diagnostic infrastructure.


**Stakeholders’ management**
* Build map and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key payers, decision\-makers, and influencers. Develop and implement engagement plans aligned with the OBU Disease’s Unit business priorities, fostering long\-term partnerships.
* Establish strategic partnerships with Health Authorities through strategic health initiatives.
* Identify, map, establish and develop strong customer engagement plans for strong and sustained relationships.
* Develop and implement plans for stakeholders’ development \& engagement in alignment with country \& MA leaders.


**Payer And Stakeholder Insights**
* Identify, analyse, and understand payer and stakeholder profiles, needs, and trends within the healthcare environment. Use these insights to tailor and communicate the local value story, demonstrating how AstraZeneca’s OBU disease medicines address specific needs across payer archetypes


**Passion For Customer**
* Maintain close contact with key stakeholders including those who have significant influence in the access decisions with major hospitals/institutions for the assigned products.


**Collaboration And Cross\-functional Support**
* Work collaboratively across functional areas, ensure alignment on key priorities, actions and activities. Serving as a resource within the region and by leveraging the expertise of others.
* Act as a liaison between the access and other cross\-functional areas, persuading, convincing or motivating a targeted audience through collaboration and direct or indirect influence.


**Corporate Responsibility**
* Maintain highest ethical standards and work in a spirit of AstraZeneca Code of Ethics, following rules \& norms set by corporate policies.
* Ensure that all conducted activities are done in accordance with local legislation and corporate standards.
* Timely report (as per respective procedures): health/environment/wellbeing related accidents; adverse events that you became aware about; change in status of your Conflict of Interest.


**Innovative Project Development**
* Create and implement impactful projects that address customer needs and foster win\-win partnerships, supporting AstraZeneca’s mission of improving patient outcomes.


**Essential For The Role**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field
* 2–4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry
* Proven track record in Oman Oncology market, with solid experience engaging payers, policymakers, and healthcare professionals to secure product access and reimbursement.
* Demonstrated strong oral, written and group communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal abilities, including influencing, negotiation, collaboration, and teamwork.
* Leadership skills with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of responsibilities with minimal guidance.
* Strategic mindset and analytical thinking, problem solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Deep knowledge of the healthcare and reimbursement landscape in Oman markets, including stakeholders, regulatory and legislative processes, and associated challenges and opportunities
* Innovative thinker with a forward\-looking approach to addressing market access challenges.


**Desirable for the role**
* Strong commercial background, ideally with a track record of bridging market access and commercial priorities.
* Exposure to market access, account management, or pre\-launch activities
* Experience working across different regions within Oman
* Proven involvement in shaping healthcare policies through participation in industry working groups or similar forums.
* Digital proficiency, including familiarity with tools and platforms that support data\-driven decision\-making and market access strategies.


**Why AstraZeneca?**
 At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients, and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
   

  

**So, what’s next?**
* Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.

data.jd_text:
Job Purpose:
 



 To lead and direct Asyad Logistics’ Freight Forwarding business in Oman, ensuring profitable growth, commercial expansion, operational excellence, and strong financial control across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance activities. The role carries full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, margin improvement, service quality, business transformation, and disciplined working capital management including timely billing, collections, and cash flow performance. The role supports Oman’s positioning as a regional logistics hub while ensuring compliance with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance, Oman Labour Law, customs regulations, and international trade requirements.
 



  





 Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:
 


* Develop and execute the Freight Forwarding strategy, annual business plan, and budget in alignment with Asyad Logistics’ growth ambitions and national logistics objectives.
* Drive commercial expansion by winning new business, penetrating target sectors, strengthening customer relationships, and building a healthy pipeline across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance services.
* Identify and develop new products, trade lanes, customer segments, and value\-added forwarding solutions that enhance revenue, competitiveness, and market share.
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with airlines, shipping lines, overseas agents, transport partners, customs stakeholders, and key government entities to improve capability, reach, and commercial positioning.
* Lead the Freight Forwarding business to support Oman’s role as a competitive regional gateway and logistics hub.
* Ensure all strategic initiatives and business activities are aligned with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance requirements, and relevant regulatory frameworks.
* Hold full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, margin improvement, cost discipline, and delivery of agreed financial targets.
* Lead end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding operations across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance to ensure service reliability, operational excellence, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive pricing discipline, job profitability, vendor cost control, and operational efficiency to improve gross margin and EBIT performance.
* Ensure strong financial leadership across the business through timely and accurate billing, reduction of revenue leakage, disciplined credit control, proactive collections follow\-up, and close monitoring of overdue receivables and cash conversion.
* Oversee operational and commercial controls to ensure timely job closure, complete cost capture, accurate invoicing, and proper handover to finance.
* Manage key cost drivers including transport procurement, vendor agreements, subcontracted services, manpower, claims exposure, and service failures.
* Ensure full compliance with customs rules, international trade regulations, internal governance requirements, and health, safety, security, and quality standards.
* Maintain service excellence and resilience across the forwarding network while ensuring competitiveness in rates, transit times, and customer responsiveness.
* Lead business improvement initiatives to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve visibility, and raise productivity across commercial and operational functions.
* Drive transformation in areas such as digital forwarding, performance dashboards, shipment visibility, pricing governance, job costing discipline, and exception management.
* Implement performance measurement frameworks that track revenue growth, gross profit, yield, billing timeliness, collections, DSO, productivity, service quality, and customer retention.
* Improve the effectiveness of the commercial and operational interface to ensure faster quotation turnaround, better conversion, smoother execution, and stronger customer experience.
* Identify structural opportunities to improve business performance, including trade lane prioritization, customer profitability management, vendor consolidation, and operating model enhancement.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and compliance processes within Freight Forwarding operations to protect profitability and reduce operational and financial leakage.
* Lead and develop the Freight Forwarding organization, including commercial, customer service, operations, customs clearance, and support teams.
* Build a high\-performance culture centered on accountability, customer focus, commercial discipline, execution quality, and continuous improvement.
* Develop organizational capability through coaching, succession planning, performance management, and Omanization initiatives.
* Set clear performance expectations for revenue generation, profitability, billing discipline, collections support, operational delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with finance, procurement, HR, IT, QHSE, and other business units to ensure strong business execution.
* Champion ethical leadership, safety, compliance, and professional standards across the Freight Forwarding business.



  





 Minimum Qualifications and Experience
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree or MBA with focus on Supply Chain/Operations.
* Professional certifications in logistics/supply chain (e.g., CSCP, FIATA, CILT) are an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years in logistics and supply chain, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record in freight forwarding, warehousing, and transport operations with full P\&L responsibility.
* Experience in developing and executing large\-scale logistics strategies and transformation projects.



 Strong understanding of GCC and international logistics markets, compliance, and trade regulations.
 



  





 Job Specific Skills:
 


* Freight Forwarding Management across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance
* P\&L and Financial Management
* Commercial Leadership and Business Development
* Margin Management, Pricing Discipline, Billing, Collections, and Working Capital Control
* Operational Excellence and Cost Optimization
* Customs, Trade Compliance, and Regulatory Management
* Strategic Partnerships and Carrier / Agent Network Management
* Business Improvement and Digital Transformation
* Strong leadership and people management skills
* Strong commercial drive and financial acumen
* Strategic and results\-oriented mindset
* Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills
* High resilience and adaptability in a dynamic market
* Strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus



 Collaborative, ethical, and performance\-driven leadership style
